news.title: Sjoeke Nusken: Everyone will have a part to play
news.title_zh: Sjoeke Nusken：每个人都可以发挥作用
news.body_en: Sjoeke Nusken believes the impact of Chelsea’s substitutes against Birmingham City underlined the importance of our whole squad as we prepare to begin our Women’s Champions League campaign this week. With European football returning and big games against Arsenal and Lyon on the horizon, there will be plenty of opportunities for players to make their mark in the weeks ahead. Melvine Malard did exactly that at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, coming off the bench to score our second goal in a 2-0 victory over Birmingham. For Nusken, the forward’s contribution was a timely reminder of the difference fresh legs can make. ‘It’s really important,’ she explained when asked about having players like Malard to call upon. ‘You can always see when they’re coming on that they bring more energy onto the pitch, and that’s what we need. ‘We have a long season ahead, so everyone is needed.’ Lexi Potter’s early opener had given the Blues the advantage, but despite creating a series of chances, we had to wait until the second half for Malard to provide some breathing space. The forward was introduced in the 63rd minute and found the net eight minutes later, helping us secure three points in front of our home supporters. ‘Playing here at Stamford Bridge with the fans was amazing,’ Nusken reflected. ‘I think we created a lot of chances, had good opportunities, and we are happy with the 2-0 win. ‘It was a little bit tight when we were winning 1-0, so it was our aim to get another goal. It was really good when Mel came in. It was such a good game from her, and a goal from her, so it was really good.’ Attention now turns to Europe, with Austria Vienna our opponents at Plough Lane on Wednesday evening as we begin the league phase of the Women’s Champions League. We then return to Stamford Bridge to face Arsenal on Sunday in the WSL and with Lyon also among the challenges to come, it is an exciting spell for the Blues, and Nusken is eager to get our European campaign under way. ‘We are happy to play Champions League again,’ she said. ‘We can’t wait to get it started.’
news.body_zh: 舍克·努斯肯认为，切尔西替补球员对阵伯明翰城的比赛突显了我们整支球队的重要性，因为我们正在准备本周开始女子冠军联赛。随着欧洲足球的回归以及对阵阿森纳和里昂的大型比赛即将到来，球员们将有很多机会在未来几周内留下自己的印记。周六，梅尔文·马拉德在斯坦福桥就做到了这一点，在 2-0 战胜伯明翰的比赛中替补出场打进了我们的第二个进球。对于努斯肯来说，这位前锋的贡献及时提醒了我们新腿可以带来的改变。当被问及是否需要像马拉德这样的球员时，她解释道：“这真的很重要。” “你总是可以看到，当他们上场时，他们会给球场带来更多的能量，而这正是我们所需要的。 “我们还有一个漫长的赛季，所以每个人都需要。”莱克西·波特的早期揭幕战为蓝军带来了优势，但尽管创造了一系列机会，我们还是不得不等到下半场让马拉德提供一些喘息的空间。这名前锋在第 63 分钟登场，八分钟后进球，帮助我们在主场球迷面前锁定三分。 “在斯坦福桥与球迷一起踢球真是太棒了，”努斯肯回忆道。 “我认为我们创造了很多机会，拥有很好的机会，我们对2-0的胜利感到高兴。 “当我们1-0获胜时，比赛有点紧张，所以我们的目标是再进一个球。梅尔上场的时候真是太棒了。她的比赛非常精彩，她的进球也非常出色。”然后我们将返回斯坦福桥，周日在 WSL 中对阵阿森纳，里昂也是即将到来的挑战之一，这对蓝军来说是一个令人兴奋的时期，努斯肯渴望让我们的欧洲联赛开始。 “我们很高兴再次参加冠军联赛，”她说。 “我们迫不及待地想开始。”

news.title: Your Star of the Match vs Birmingham City revealed!
news.title_zh: 您对阵伯明翰城的比赛之星揭晓！
news.body_en: It was another three points for the Blues on Saturday afternoon as we beat Birmingham City 2-0, and users of the Chelsea Official App have decided on their Star of the Match! Goals from Lexi Potter and Melvine Malard helped Chelsea beat Birmingham City 2-0 at Stamford Bridge, taking our tally to seven points from our opening three Women’s Super League fixtures. The Blues made an impressive start and took the lead after eight minutes. Ellie Carpenter burst into the box and picked out Alyssa Thompson, whose flick was saved by Sophie Baggaley. Potter reacted quickest to fire the rebound high into the net. We continued to create chances, with Thompson shooting narrowly over and Carpenter twice threatening. Despite registering 14 attempts to Birmingham’s one before the interval, Sonia Bompastor’s side had to settle for a slender advantage at the break. Thompson went close again after the restart, while Hannah Hampton intervened to deny Wilma Leidhammar an equaliser. Substitute Malard then provided breathing space in the 71st minute, pouncing on hesitation over a backpass to finish from close range. Malard almost turned provider for fellow substitute Maika Hamano as we looked for a third, before Hampton dealt with a late Birmingham free-kick to protect her clean sheet. Fans have been voting for their standout performer since Saturday's match and now we can deliver you the results! Kadiesha Buchanan's solid performance in the heart of our defence saw her take eight per cent of the vote, while Malard's finish and all-round display saw the striker receive 17 per cent. Academy graduate Potter took 29 per cent of your votes but users of the Chelsea Official App agreed with the broadcasters and named Carpenter our Star of the Match with the Australia international receiving 47 per cent of the vote.
news.body_zh: 周六下午，蓝军以 2-0 击败伯明翰城，又拿下三分，切尔西官方应用程序的用户已经选出了他们的比赛之星！莱克西·波特和梅尔文·马拉德的进球帮助切尔西在斯坦福桥以 2-0 击败伯明翰城，使我们在前三场女足超级联赛中的积分达到了 7 分。蓝军开局令人印象深刻，八分钟后取得领先。埃莉·卡彭特冲进禁区，挑出了艾莉莎·汤普森，后者的动作被索菲·巴格利救出。波特反应最快，将篮板射入网内。我们继续创造机会，汤普森的投篮稍稍高出，卡彭特两次威胁。尽管在中场休息之前，伯明翰队有 14 次射门，但索尼娅·邦帕斯特的球队在中场休息时不得不以微弱优势接受。汤普森在重新开始后再次接近，而汉娜·汉普顿介入阻止威尔玛·莱德哈玛扳平比分。第71分钟，替补出场的马拉德提供了喘息的机会，他在一次回传中犹豫不决，近距离射门得分。当我们寻找第三个球员时，马拉德几乎成为了替补队员滨野麦卡的提供者，随后汉普顿处理了伯明翰最后时刻的任意球以保护她的不失球。自周六比赛以来，球迷们一直在投票选出表现出色的球员，现在我们可以向您提供结果！卡迪莎·布坎南 (Kadiesha Buchanan) 在我们后防核心的出色表现让她获得了 8% 的选票，而马拉德 (Malard) 的射门和全能表现让这位前锋获得了 17% 的选票。学院毕业生波特获得了 29% 的选票，但切尔西官方应用程序的用户同意广播公司的观点，并将卡彭特评为本场比赛之星，而这位澳大利亚国脚获得了 47% 的选票。

news.title: Levi Colwill on using the international break to 'become a better team'
news.title_zh: 列维·科尔威尔谈利用国际比赛日“成为一支更好的球队”
news.body_en: No player wants to enter an international break – let alone one that lasts for three weeks – on the back of a defeat. Yet Levi Colwill believes those remaining with the Blues must use it as an opportunity to 'become a better team' under Xabi Alonso. The opening weeks of the campaign have brought contrasting emotions for Chelsea players, staff and supporters alike. Entertaining victories have been recorded while progress has been made in the Carabao Cup, but there have also been disappointing defeats. Friday night's trip to Brentford was one of the latter. Alonso's side started well at the Gtech Community Stadium and controlled the opening 45 minutes, yet things unravelled in the second period as the Bees struck three times without reply. After our opening five top-flight matches, the Blues have claimed seven points. Naturally, that leaves room for improvement, which Colwill is acutely aware of. The 23-year-old, who missed most of last season due to a knee injury, has not been included in the England squad for their upcoming UEFA Nations League fixtures. It means he will remain with the Blues and continue working with Alonso during the international break, something he is not taking for granted. When asked to reflect on our start to the campaign, and the improvements we can make, the Academy graduate said: '[There have been] some good bits, some other not so good bits. 'Luckily we’ve got a while now to try and improve. Hopefully, we will come out the other side flying, pick up our play, and become a better team.'
news.body_zh: 没有球员愿意在一场失利后进入国际比赛日，更不用说持续三周的国际比赛日了。然而，列维·科尔威尔相信那些留在蓝军的人必须利用它作为一个机会，在哈维·阿隆索的带领下“成为一支更好的球队”。赛季开始的几周给切尔西球员、工作人员和球迷带来了截然不同的情绪。卡拉宝杯取得了进步，取得了令人兴奋的胜利，但也有令人失望的失败。周五晚上前往布伦特福德的旅程就是后者之一。阿隆索的球队在 ​​Gtech 社区体育场开局良好，并控制了开场 45 分钟，但在第二节比赛中，蜜蜂队三度进攻却没有任何反击，情况出现了崩溃。在我们的前五场顶级联赛比赛之后，蓝军已经拿下了七分。当然，这留下了改进的空间，科尔威尔敏锐地意识到这一点。这位23岁的球员因膝伤缺席了上赛季的大部分比赛，他没有入选英格兰队即将举行的欧洲国家联赛的大名单。这意味着他将留在蓝军，并在国际比赛日期间继续与阿隆索一起工作，他并不认为这是理所当然的。当被要求反思我们的活动开始以及我们可以做出的改进时，这位学院毕业生说：“[有]一些好的方面，也有一些不太好的方面。 “幸运的是，我们现在有一段时间来尝试和改进。希望我们能够从另一边飞翔，恢复我们的表现，成为一支更好的球队。

news.title: Ellie Carpenter on contributing to the attack and getting the job done
news.title_zh: 艾莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 讲述了此次袭击并完成了工作
news.body_en: After earning the Player of the Match trophy in our 2-0 win over Birmingham City, Ellie Carpenter explained why she’s enjoying her more attacking role in the side this season. The right wing-back took 16 touches in the opposition box throughout the contest – more than any other Chelsea player – and was delighted with the afternoon’s result. ‘It feels really nice to win today,’ said Carpenter. ‘The most important thing was a home win, the three points and a clean sheet. ‘Birmingham came out strongly, especially in the second half. We had to defend a lot there, but I'm proud of the team that we kept a clean sheet, and we kept to the game plan.' The Australia international has garnered praise for her all-round performances this season, and she has a theory about why she has been standing out. ‘I'm just trying to bring my best every game and also every day in training to help this team achieve our goals,’ she explained. ‘Obviously, I’m now in my second season here at Chelsea, and in London, so I’m feeling a bit more comfortable and getting a little bit of a different role in this formation. ‘It allows me to get forward and attack a little bit more, so I’m really enjoying that freedom.’ After securing the three points at Stamford Bridge, Carpenter was keen to praise team-mate Melvine Malard, who she previously played with at Lyon, for scoring the goal that gave us some much-needed breathing space with 20 minutes to play. Malard was brought on as a 63rd-minute substitute to make her first appearance for Chelsea in the Women’s Super League, and within eight minutes of coming on, she bagged her first league goal for her new club too. ‘We got that important second goal with Melvine,’ Carpenter continued. ‘I’m very happy for her to have her first minutes in the WSL for Chelsea and her first goal, so it's great for her, and also great for the team. ‘We always want to score more goals. But the fact that we're creating the goals and the goalscoring opportunities is good for us. Hopefully we can build on that. We have Champions League in midweek, and obviously Arsenal next weekend. If we keep playing well, performing well and creating those chances, I'm sure the goals will come.’ Chelsea Women investor Alexis Ohanaian was in attendance at Stamford Bridge on Saturday alongside his wife Serena Williams and their two daughters. Carpenter was asked about her opinion of stars from other sports watching her and her team-mates play at the Bridge, and her response showed her passion for women athletes lifting each other up. ‘I think it's amazing,’ she smiled. ‘Women's sport in general is massive, and it’s great to see different athletes and legends at the game. It's really cool to have Serena present and bringing the vibes.’ Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 在我们 2-0 战胜伯明翰城的比赛中获得全场最佳球员奖杯后，埃莉·卡彭特解释了为什么她在本赛季更喜欢在球队中担任进攻角色。这位右翼卫在整场比赛中在对方禁区内触球 16 次，比其他任何切尔西球员都多，他对下午的结果感到很高兴。 “今天获胜的感觉真的很好，”卡彭特说。 “最重要的是主场胜利、三分和零失球。 “伯明翰表现强劲，尤其是在下半场。我们在那里必须进行很多防守，但我为球队保持不失球而感到自豪，并且我们遵守了比赛计划。”这位澳大利亚国脚本赛季的全面表现赢得了赞誉，她对自己为何能够脱颖而出有自己的一套理论。 “我只是尽力在每场比赛以及每天的训练中发挥出最好的水平，帮助这支球队实现我们的目标，”她解释道。 “显然，现在是我在切尔西和伦敦的第二个赛季，所以我感觉更舒服了，并且在这个阵型中扮演了一些不同的角色。 “这让我能够向前推进，进攻更多，所以我真的很享受这种自由。”在斯坦福桥拿下三分后，卡彭特热衷于赞扬她之前在里昂并肩作战的队友梅尔文·马拉德，他的进球让我们在比赛还剩 20 分钟时获得了急需的喘息空间。马拉德在第 63 分钟替补上场，这是她在女足超级联赛中首次代表切尔西出场，在上场后的八分钟内，她也为新俱乐部打进了第一个联赛进球。 “我们和梅尔文一起打进了重要的第二个进球，”卡彭特继续说道。 “我很高兴她能在切尔西女足联赛中上场，并打进第一个进球，这对她来说很棒，对球队来说也很棒。 ‘我们总是想进更多球。但事实上，我们正在创造进球和进球机会，这对我们来说是有好处的。希望我们能够以此为基础。周中我们有欧冠联赛，下周末当然还有阿森纳。如果我们继续打好比赛，表现出色并创造机会，我相信进球就会到来。”切尔西女足投资者亚历克西斯·奥哈纳扬周六与他的妻子塞雷娜·威廉姆斯和他们的两个女儿一起出席了斯坦福桥球场。卡彭特被问及对其他运动明星观看她和队友在桥上比赛的看法，她的回答表明了她对女运动员互相帮助的热情。 “我觉得这太棒了，”她微笑着说。 “总的来说，女子运动规模很大，很高兴在比赛中看到不同的运动员和传奇人物。有塞雷娜在场并带来这种氛围真是太酷了。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: PL2 report: Cobham Next Gen 3-1 Fulham
news.title_zh: PL2 报道：科巴姆下一代 3-1 富勒姆
news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen came from behind to beat Fulham on Saturday afternoon, with Harrison Bettoni and Reggie Watson turning the game around early in the second half before Leo Black produced a fine finish to seal the points. Chelsea dominated much of the opening period and struck the woodwork twice through Chizaram Ezenwata and Black, with Fulham goalkeeper Dino Kaiser repeatedly called upon to keep the Blues at bay. Fulham had threatened on the counter throughout the afternoon and that was how they took the lead five minutes before the interval. Dan Casey cut inside with two Chelsea players in pursuit before finding the bottom corner with a right-footed finish. The Blues continued to create opportunities after the restart and were level seven minutes into the second half. Ezenwata showed good awareness to feed Watson, who squared the ball for Bettoni to stroke a left-footed finish into the net. Just three minutes later, Chelsea were ahead. Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli – fresh from his senior Blues debut – picked out Watson, who cut inside before firing a right-footed effort into net for his fifth goal of the season and first from open play. Chelsea continued to look the more threatening side, with Nicoll-Jazuli going close again before the decisive third arrived with 13 minutes remaining. Ezenwata was again involved, showing excellent awareness to find Black inside the area. The defender turned beautifully before finding the bottom corner with a composed finish to make it 3-1. Black had earlier struck the crossbar and his goal capped an impressive individual display, while Ezenwata's contribution included hitting the post and providing the assist for the third. The result extends Cobham Next Gen's winning run in Premier League 2 to three matches, following victories over West Ham United and Arsenal. Fulham had started the day unbeaten in the competition, having collected seven points from their opening three fixtures. Cobham Next Gen's next scheduled fixture is in the EFL Trophy, when we travel to face Reading on Tuesday 13 October. news.title: Sonia Bompastor delivers Lauren James injury update and reflects on Birmingham win
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 通报劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 伤情最新情况并反思伯明翰的胜利
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has explained the reason behind Lauren James' absence from the squad in our 2-0 victory over Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon. After scoring in our first two Women's Super League matches of the season, LJ was not named in the squad against Birmingham City, and Bompastor explained the reason for her absence. 'In our last training session, she just got a knock,' said the head coach. 'She will probably be out of the game on Wednesday, but we are hoping for her to be back next weekend. 'I am a manager who really wants my team to work with a lot of intensity. We work hard, and the duels are sometimes important in training, but also the intensity. We work a lot on the counter-press. I'm asking my players to come on the pitch and do their best and bring a lot of energy. 'So in this environment, if you want to be able to win this league, you want to also be able to win the Champions League; you need to work at your maximum intensity. And when you are demanding like this with the players, especially when they play every three days, injuries can happen. 'Every team gets injuries. It's more about how you perform when you have injured players, and how long they need to be able to return to the pitch. That's the thing we are focusing on right now to make sure when we have an injury, we optimise the performance and the recovery for them to get back on the pitch as soon as possible without taking high risks.' Goals from Lexi Potter and Melvine Malard secured a 2-0 win against Birmingham, but the goals were spaced out by almost an hour. Our first was netted after just eight minutes, and Bompastor explained that until Malard doubled the lead, she was concerned Birmingham might find a way back into the contest like Aston Villa did in the first match of the season. 'I think we all felt the same,' she continued. 'Probably we all were thinking about our first opening game here. I'm really pleased with the performance again. We dominated and controlled the game for the most part of the 90 minutes. 'Probably we lost a little bit of control starting the second half in the first 10 or 15 minutes, but we scored an early goal and started strong. I think we could've been winning 2-0 or 3-0 at half-time, because we created enough. 'With Melvine, we were able to score the second goal, and it was a real relief because when you score the second goal, you can manage the game in a different way. I'm pleased with the performance and the result at the end.' Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托解释了周六下午我们在斯坦福桥 2-0 战胜伯明翰城的比赛中劳伦·詹姆斯缺席的原因。在本赛季前两场女足超级联赛进球后，LJ 没有入选对阵伯明翰城的大名单，邦帕斯托解释了她缺席的原因。 “在我们的最后一次训练中，她刚刚受到了撞击，”主教练说。 “她可能会缺席周三的比赛，但我们希望她下周末能回来。 “我是一名真正希望我的团队高强度工作的经理。我们努力训练，有时训练中的对抗很重要，但强度也很重要。我们在反压力方面做了很多工作。我要求我的球员上场并尽最大努力并带来大量能量。 “所以在这种环境下，如果你想赢得联赛冠军，你也希望能够赢得欧冠联赛；你需要以最大强度工作。当你对球员提出这样的要求时，尤其是当他们每三天比赛一次时，受伤的情况就会发生。 “每支球队都会受伤。更重要的是当你有球员受伤时你的表现，以及他们需要多长时间才能回到球场。这就是我们现在关注的事情，以确保当我们受伤时，我们优化表现和恢复，让他们尽快回到球场，而不需要承担高风险。”莱克西·波特和梅尔文·马拉德的进球帮助伯明翰 2-0 获胜，但两粒进球相差近一个小时。我们的第一个进球在仅仅八分钟后就取得了进球，邦帕斯特解释说，在马拉德将领先优势扩大一倍之前，她担心伯明翰可能会像阿斯顿维拉在本赛季第一场比赛中那样找到重返比赛的方法。 “我想我们都有同样的感觉，”她继续说道。 “也许我们都在考虑我们在这里的第一场揭幕战。我对再次的表现感到非常满意。我们在90分钟的大部分时间里统治并控制了比赛。 “下半场一开始，我们可能在前 10 或 15 分钟就失去了一点控制权，但我们很早就取得了进球，并且开局强劲。我认为我们本可以在半场以 2-0 或 3-0 获胜，因为我们创造了足够的机会。 “有了梅尔文，我们能够打进第二个进球，这真的让人松了一口气，因为当你打进第二个进球时，你可以用不同的方式管理比赛。我对最终的表现和结果感到满意。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Match Report: Chelsea 2-0 Birmingham City
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 2-0 伯明翰城
news.body_en: Goals from Lexi Potter and Melvine Malard secured a professional 2-0 victory over Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon. Another day, another strong start to a match from Chelsea. We flew out of the blocks once again when Lexi Potter was alive to a rebound off a save from an Alyssa Thompson shot, putting us ahead at the Bridge after eight minutes. Birmingham dug in from that point and provided a couple of dangerous moments on the break, but we defended those well as we went in at half-time with a one-goal advantage. Second-half substitute Melvine Malard put the contest beyond doubt with 20 minutes to play, capitalising on a Birmingham defensive error. This was a good day at the Bridge, with the three points secured before we face Arsenal here next Sunday. Sonia Bompastor made just two alterations to her starting line-up, bringing in Veerle Buurman and Sandy Baltimore for Katie McCabe and Lauren James. The match began with a cross each from Baltimore and Carpenter, as we showed our intent to penetrate the Birmingham penalty area at the earliest opportunity. And the breakthrough came after just eight minutes, as Carpenter burst through into the box from the right-hand flank, beating the full-back and crossing to Thompson whose clever flicked needed saving. When the ball broke to Potter near the penalty spot, the midfielder opened our account with a superbly struck effort high into the back of the net. After a short spell of Birmingham attacks, we went forward once more. Thompson sent her attempt just over the bar, and with 30 minutes gone, another dangerous ball in from Baltimore was almost steered home by Carpenter from six yards out. We continued to push for more, and when Thompson crossed from the right, Sjoeke Nusken hit the bar with a header, but it wouldn't have counted as the flag went up for offside. A fast break from Wieke Kaptein saw the midfielder lay the ball off to Carpenter on the right, and the Australian proceeded to sting the goalkeeper's gloves with a powerful drive. The half ended with our 14 shots as opposed to just one from Birmingham, but there was more work to do after the interval. Thompson went close again soon after the restart and was denied a spot-kick when she was brought down in the penalty area when one-on-one with goalkeeper Sophie Baggaley. Up the other end, only a quick intervention from Hannah Hampton prevented Wilma Leidhammar from netting an equaliser from close range. On came striker Melvine Malard in place of Baltimore as we looked to capitalise on our advantage, and Maika Hamano was also introduced shortly afterwards. And as the visitors went close with a shot that went just wide of the post, we rushed forward from a Hampton goal-kick, and Malard capitalised on a moment's hesitation on a pass back to Baggaley to convert from close range. As the minutes ticked towards full-time, Malard played a ball across the box for Hamano, but the Japan international couldn't quite connect with the cross. With the points seemingly secure, Bompastor took the opportunity to make a triple substitution, swapping Nathalie Bjorn, Giulia Dragoni and Katie McCabe for Kadeisha Buchanan, Nusken and Thompson. Hampton palmed away a ball that flew into the box from a Birmingham free-kick in stoppage time, preserving the clean sheet after a professional display from Chelsea. We earn our first win at Stamford Bridge since making it our new permanent home in the summer, sending our fans home happy. We have gained seven points from our opening three WSL matches this season We play the first game in the league phase of the Women's Champions League, as we take on Austria Vienna at Plough Lane on Wednesday evening, before returning to Stamford Bridge next Sunday for our London derby against Arsenal. news.body_zh: 周六下午，莱克西·波特和梅尔文·马拉德的进球帮助球队在斯坦福桥以 2-0 战胜伯明翰城。又一天，切尔西的比赛又取得了强劲的开局。当莱克西·波特（Lexi Potter）在阿丽莎·汤普森（Alyssa Thompson）的射门扑救中抢到篮板时，我们再次飞出了禁区，八分钟后我们在桥上取得了领先。伯明翰从那时起就开始反击，并在中场休息时创造了几个危险的时刻，但我们很好地防守了这些时刻，半场结束时我们以一球的优势进入了比赛。下半场替补梅尔文·马拉德利用伯明翰的防守失误，在比赛还剩 20 分钟时让比赛变得毫无疑问。这是蓝桥美好的一天，我们在下周日在这里对阵阿森纳之前已经拿到了三分。索尼娅·邦帕斯特只对她的首发阵容进行了两次调整，用维尔勒·布尔曼和桑迪·巴尔的摩替换了凯蒂·麦凯布和劳伦·詹姆斯。比赛开始时，巴尔的摩和卡彭特分别传中，我们表现出了尽早突破伯明翰禁区的意图。仅仅八分钟后，突破就出现了，卡彭特从右侧突入禁区，击败了边后卫，传中给汤普森，汤普森的巧妙射门需要扑救。当球传到点球点附近的波特手中时，这位中场球员以一脚精彩的射门破门得分。在伯明翰的短暂进攻之后，我们再次前进。汤普森的射门稍稍高出横梁，30分钟过去了，巴尔的摩的另一个危险球差点被卡彭特在六码外击中。我们继续进攻，当汤普森从右路传中时，斯乔克·努斯肯头球击中横梁，但由于越位，所以这不算在内。维克·卡普坦 (Wieke Kaptein) 快速突破，将球传给右侧的卡彭特 (Carpenter)，澳大利亚人用强力的射门刺痛了守门员的手套。上半场结束时，我们射门 14 次，而伯明翰只射门 1 次，但中场休息后还有更多工作要做。比赛重新开始后不久，汤普森再次接近，但在禁区内与门将索菲·巴加利一对一时被撞倒，被拒绝点球。在另一端，只有汉娜·汉普顿的快速干预才阻止威尔玛·莱德哈马尔近距离扳平比分。当我们希望利用我们的优势时，前锋梅尔文·马拉德取代了巴尔的摩，不久之后也引进了滨野舞香。当客队的一脚射门稍稍偏出门柱时，汉普顿开出球门球，我们冲上前去，马拉德利用短暂的犹豫，将球回传给巴加利，近距离射门。随着比赛时间的临近，马拉德在禁区为滨野传出一脚传球，但这位日本国脚未能接应传中。在积分看似稳稳的情况下，邦帕斯特趁机进行了三次换人，用纳塔莉·比约恩、朱莉娅·德拉格尼和凯蒂·麦凯布换下卡德莎·布坎南、努斯肯和汤普森。汉普顿在补时阶段将伯明翰任意球飞入禁区的球挡出，在切尔西的专业表现后保住了不失球。自从夏天把斯坦福桥作为我们的新永久主场以来，我们在斯坦福桥赢得了第一场胜利，让我们的球迷高兴回家。我们在本赛季 WSL 的前三场比赛中获得了 7 分。我们将进行女子冠军联赛联赛阶段的第一场比赛，周三晚上我们将在普劳巷迎战奥地利维也纳，然后下周日将返回斯坦福桥参加对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、布尔曼、布坎南（比约恩 87）、青铜（c）、努斯肯（德拉戈尼 87）、波特、卡普坦（滨野 73）、沃尔什、巴尔的摩（马拉德 63）、汤普森（麦凯布 87）未上场替补：彭、鲁兹、吉尔马、拉斯得分手：波特 8、马拉德 71伯明翰城：巴格利，莱维塞尔，李（天野66），纳尔松德，莱德哈马尔，克罗斯韦特，麦肯纳，特纳（中），赫特雷，宫川，赫伦未使用的替补：托马斯，哈里斯，拉斯托克莱，库克，霍洛威，科内特，埃法埃法，萨里出席人数：4,793裁判：爱丽丝帕克不要错过我们巨大的伦敦斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的德比战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Under-18 Premier League report: Chelsea 5-0 Bournemouth
news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：切尔西5-0伯恩茅斯
news.body_en:
Chelsea Under-18s recorded a second successive victory in the Under-18 Premier League as Jashayde Greenwood, Isaac McGillvary, Jacob Dako, Eden Perez and an own goal secured a 5-0 win over Bournemouth at Cobham.
 The Blues took control during the first half, with Greenwood and McGillvary finding the net before the interval. Bournemouth were reduced to ten men early in the second half when Kelvin Arthur was shown a straight red card for a challenge on Dako, who then converted the resulting free-kick. Perez added a fourth before a deflection off Jake Drewett completed the scoring. Chelsea had the first sight of goal after three minutes when Lewi Richards shot over from the centre of the box. Andrew Pennie then tested Bournemouth goalkeeper William Upstell, who saved the midfielder's effort from outside the box before holding Dako's follow-up. The breakthrough arrived in the 14th minute. Greenwood held up Toby Bell’s long pass, picked out Gabriel Sambou who slipped in the striker. He burst clear and finished right-footed into the bottom-left corner to put the young Blues ahead. Bournemouth continued to threaten from distance, but Chelsea doubled our advantage in the 26th minute. Pennie provided the set-up for McGillvary, who made no mistake from the centre of the box. Greenwood went close to adding another before the break, while Pennie was also denied by Upstell. Richards then rose highest from a corner in stoppage time but headed just over. Chelsea continued to press after the restart, with Pennie seeing another effort saved before one of the game's decisive moments arrived in the 56th minute. Dako, racing clear on goal, was caught by a challenge from Bournemouth substitute Kelvin Arthur. He was shown a straight red card with the foul having taken place just outside the box. Dako dusted himself down and took responsibility for the resulting free-kick, thumping a right-footed effort into the top-left corner to make it 3-0. The Blues continued to create opportunities and added a fourth in the 71st minute. Dako squared for Perez, who walked the ball in from close range. There was time for a fifth, as substitute Bilal Shah drove into the box and saw his effort take a hefty deflection off Drewett to complete the scoring. The result gives Chelsea a fourth league victory of the season and leaves the young Blues with 12 points from six Under-18 Premier League matches. It is also a second consecutive league win at Cobham following last month's 6-1 victory over Reading. Chelsea Under-18s will return to action on Saturday 10 October, when we welcome Manchester United to Cobham in the Under-18 Premier League Cup. news.body_zh:
切尔西 U-18 队凭借贾沙德·格林伍德、艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里、雅各布·达科、艾登·佩雷斯和乌龙球，在科巴姆以 5-0 战胜伯恩茅斯，取得了 U-18 英超联赛的二连胜。
 蓝军在上半场控制了局面，格林伍德和麦吉尔瓦里在中场休息前进球。下半场一开始，伯恩茅斯队就只剩下十人了，凯尔文·阿瑟因为对达科犯规而被直接出示红牌，随后达科主罚任意球。佩雷斯 (Perez) 打进第四球，随后杰克·德鲁伊特 (Jake Drewett) 的一次偏转完成得分。三分钟后，刘易·理查兹从禁区中央射门，切尔西队首次进球。安德鲁·佩尼随后测试了伯恩茅斯门将威廉·厄普斯特尔，后者在禁区外扑出了中场球员的射门，然后又抓住了达科的跟进。第14分钟，突破到来。格林伍德接住了托比·贝尔的长传，接住了插上前锋的加布里埃尔·桑布。他突然突破，右脚射入左下角，帮助年轻的蓝军取得领先。伯恩茅斯继续进行远距离威胁，但切尔西在第 26 分钟将优势扩大一倍。彭尼为麦吉尔瓦里提供了传球机会，麦吉尔瓦里在禁区中央没有犯任何错误。格林伍德在中场休息前差点再添一球，而彭尼也被Upstell拒绝了。伤停补时阶段，理查兹从角球处起脚射门，但头球稍稍高出。比赛重新开始后，切尔西继续施压，佩尼的另一次射门被扑出，比赛的决定性时刻之一在第 56 分钟到来。达科冲向球门，却遭到伯恩茅斯替补凯尔文·阿瑟的挑衅。由于犯规发生在禁区外，他被直接出示红牌。达科拍拍身上的灰尘，主罚任意球，右脚射门左上角，比分变为3-0。蓝军继续创造机会，并在第71分钟再添第四个机会。达科（Dako）为佩雷斯（Perez）摆出姿势，佩雷斯近距离将球送入。比赛还剩第五个进球的时候，替补出场的比拉尔·沙阿（Bilal Shah）冲入禁区，他的射门被德鲁伊特（Drewett）严重偏转，完成得分。这一结果让切尔西获得了本赛季的第四场联赛胜利，这支年轻的蓝军在 6 场 U-18 英超联赛中积 12 分。这也是科巴姆继上个月6-1战胜雷丁之后连续第二场联赛获胜。切尔西 18 岁以下青年队将于 10 月 10 日星期六重返赛场，届时我们将迎来曼联前往科巴姆参加 18 岁以下英超联赛杯比赛。切尔西：托比·贝尔、刘易斯·理查兹、加布里埃尔·桑布、丹特·维特、雅各布·霍尔、艾萨克·巴杜·达席尔瓦、伊登·佩雷斯、雅各布·达科、贾沙伊德·格林伍德、艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里、安德鲁·彭尼（比拉尔·沙阿 78）未上场替补：艾萨克·科林森、杰克·穆雷、约什·亨利、夸米纳·安帕 进球者：格林伍德 14、麦吉尔瓦里 26、达科 58、佩雷斯 71、德鲁伊特乌龙球 78 主教练：丹·霍根 伯恩茅斯：威廉·厄普斯特尔、哈雷·辛普森、艾丹·巴蒂斯塔·关切斯（凯尔文·亚瑟 45）、乔·斯彭斯、扎克·萨顿、达马尼·科尔尼、杰克·德鲁伊特（菲卡约·索兰克 86）、汤姆·斯塔基（马克斯·柯林斯 36）、阿德里安·奥卢万德（汤姆·罗宾逊） 62), Leyland Waite, Denzel Decardi-Nelson (Kian Symmans 62) 未上场替补：扎克·梅林，拉弗蒂·瓦瓦苏尔 被罚下场：凯尔文·亚瑟 56 经理：詹姆斯·洛伊

news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made three changes to her Chelsea starting XI for our WSL clash against Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge this afternoon. We take on Amy Merricks' side following our resounding 5-0 victory away at Manchester United last weekend, and we go in search of another three points in the Women's Super League this lunchtime. Veerle Buurman comes into the defence in place of Katie McCabe, and Sandy Baltimore replaces Lauren James as Bompastor rotates her side with a packed schedule in mind. Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter retains her place in the starting XI after drawing praise from Bompastor after her performance against Manchester United. As confirmed in Bompastor's pre-match press conference, trio Nathalie Bjorn, Naomi Girma and Melvine Malard have returned to fitness and are all named on today's bench. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Buurman, Buchanan, Bronze (c), Nusken, Potter, Kaptein, Walsh, Baltimore, Thompson Chelsea substitutes: Peng, Rudz, McCabe, Dragoni, Bjorn, Girma, Malard, Las, Hamano Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 今天下午在斯坦福桥对阵伯明翰城的 WSL 比赛中，索尼娅·邦帕斯特对她的切尔西首发阵容做出了三项调整。继上周末客场5-0大胜曼联之后，我们将迎战艾米·梅里克斯的球队，我们将在午餐时间在女足超级联赛中争取另外三分。维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 代替凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 进入防守位置，桑迪·巴尔的摩 (Sandy Baltimore) 取代劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James)，邦帕斯托 (Bompastor) 则在日程安排紧凑的情况下轮换阵容。切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特在对阵曼联的比赛中的表现得到了邦帕斯特的赞扬，她保留了首发阵容中的位置。正如邦帕斯托的赛前新闻发布会所证实的那样，三人组纳塔莉·比约恩、娜奥米·吉尔玛和梅尔文·马拉德已经恢复健康，并且都被列入今天的替补席上。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、布尔曼、布坎南、青铜（中）、努斯肯、波特、卡普坦、沃尔什、巴尔的摩、汤普森 切尔西替补：彭、鲁兹、麦凯布、德拉格尼、比约恩、吉尔马、马拉德、拉斯、哈马诺 不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的大型伦敦德比！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: The day Jimmy Greaves captained the Blues - and scored four!
news.title_zh: 吉米·格里夫斯 (Jimmy Greaves) 担任蓝军队长的那一天 - 并攻入四球！
news.body_en: On the fifth anniversary of the great Jimmy Greaves' death, we tell the story of the day he captained Chelsea for the first and only time, saying his farewells in the way he knew best... ‘They carried me off like I were the FA Cup.’ In 1961, the Italian Football Association lifted a ban that forbid its teams signing foreign footballers. Almost immediately some of Serie A’s giants turned an interested eye in the direction of England, where players’ earning potential was at that point still capped by the maximum footballers’ wage - £20 a week. Jimmy Greaves was Chelsea’s star man and our chairman Joe Mears knew he was hot property. The youngest man to score 100 league goals, a record that stands to this day, Greaves’s extraordinary goalscoring touch never wavered from the moment he marked his first team debut with an equaliser in a 1-1 draw at Tottenham in August 1957. His performance that day left quite an impression on the esteemed journalist Charles Buchan, writing for the News Chronicle. ‘Only 17 years old, Greaves showed the ball control, confidence and positional strength of a seasoned campaigner. It was the finest first-ever League game I have seen from any youngster.’ As consistent as Greaves was in front of goal, the defence behind him struggled to keep opponents at bay, ruining any chance we had of lifting silverware. In his autobiography Greaves singles out a meek FA Cup exit at home to Fourth Division Crewe in January 1961 as particularly jarring, helping intensify his desire to move away from SW6. Mears knew Greaves’ value and was not afraid to sell, although ideally he would not transfer to a fellow English club, so when AC Milan came calling a deal was quickly struck. The forward’s final game for the club was our final match of the 1960/61 season, at home to Nottingham Forest. Greaves was named as captain to honour his phenomenal efforts in a blue shirt (pictured top, left), and he signed off in the way only he knew how to, by finding the back of the net – four times! Chelsea won a thriller 4-3, and it was the perfect way for the Stamford Bridge hero to bow out. That was his 13th Chelsea hat-trick – and his sixth of that season alone - and after the game he was carried off the pitch on the shoulders of adoring supporters, pictured below. At White Hart Lane 64 years ago, Greaves stepped on the field as a Chelsea player for the first time, against a team he would later represent for over eight years. After the match the Times newspaper observed of the 17-year-old prodigy that ‘Greaves may have a rich future’. Little did they know just how rich it would be, with Greaves' legacy as one of English's football's finest long secured.
news.body_zh: 在伟大的吉米·格里夫斯逝世五周年之际，我们讲述了他第一次也是唯一一次担任切尔西队长的那一天的故事，并以他最熟悉的方式进行了告别……“他们把我带走了，就像我带走了足总杯一样。”1961年，意大利足协取消了一项禁止其球队签下外籍球员的禁令。几乎立刻，一些意甲豪门就将感兴趣的目光投向了英格兰，当时英格兰球员的收入潜力仍然受到球员最高工资——每周 20 英镑的限制。吉米·格里夫斯是切尔西的明星球员，我们的主席乔·米尔斯知道他是炙手可热的人物。格里夫斯是联赛中打入 100 粒进球最年轻的球员，这一纪录至今仍保持着。从 1957 年 8 月在 1-1 战平托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中扳平比分，完成一线队首秀的那一刻起，格里夫斯非凡的进球手感就从未动摇过。那天他的表现给《新闻纪事报》撰稿的受人尊敬的记者查尔斯·巴肯留下了深刻的印象。 “年仅 17 岁的格里夫斯就展现出了一名经验丰富的球员所具备的控球能力、自信和位置优势。这是我所见过的年轻人中最精彩的首场联赛。”尽管格里夫斯在门前表现稳定，但他身后的防守却很难阻止对手，毁掉了我们举起奖杯的任何机会。格里夫斯在他的自传中特别指出，1961 年 1 月足总杯主场输给第四级联赛克鲁队的那场比赛特别令人震惊，这更加强烈了他离开 SW6 的愿望。米尔斯知道格里夫斯的价值，并且并不害怕出售，尽管理想情况下他不会转会到其他英国俱乐部，所以当AC米兰打电话时，交易很快就达成了。这位前锋为俱乐部效力的最后一场比赛是我们 1960/61 赛季的最后一场比赛，主场对阵诺丁汉森林。格里夫斯被任命为队长，以表彰他身着蓝色球衣（上​​图左）所做出的非凡努力，他以只有他知道的方式结束了比赛，四次进球！切尔西以 4-3 惊险获胜，这是这位斯坦福桥英雄的完美谢幕方式。这是他在切尔西的第 13 次帽子戏法，也是他那个赛季的第六次帽子戏法。赛后，他被崇拜的支持者的肩膀抬出了球场，如下图所示。 64 年前，在白鹿巷球场，格里夫斯首次以切尔西球员的身份踏上赛场，对手是一支他后来效力了八年多的球队。赛后《泰晤士报》评论了这位17岁的神童，“格里夫斯可能有一个美好的未来”。他们几乎不知道这将是多么富有，因为格里夫斯作为英格兰足球最优秀的球员之一的遗产早已得到保障。

news.title: Levi Colwill accepts there is a 'lot to work on' after Brentford defeat
news.title_zh: 列维·科尔威尔承认布伦特福德失利后还有“很多工作要做”
news.body_en: Disappointment was etched across the face of Levi Colwill as he undertook the post-match media duties following our 3-0 defeat at Brentford. It was a result, as our captain for the night admitted, that hurt. The final scoreline didn't necessarily reflect Chelsea's performance at the Gtech Community Stadium. We controlled much of the opening period, limiting Brentford to just one shot on target despite a barrage of long throw-ins. We had created a couple of opportunities of our own, with Caoimhin Kelleher denying Pedro Neto and Morgan Rogers, who also had a late first-half attempt blocked on its way to goal. As the players emerged for the second half, the game was delicately poised. Unfortunately, it tipped the way of the hosts. Jaidon Anthony headed home just after the hour mark, Igor Thiago then netted, and Fabio Carvalho put gloss on Brentford's victory in stoppage time. It was a disappointing evening for the Blues. Colwill, who skippered the side in Reece James' absence due to injury, was honest in his reflection on the performance. He accepted the second-half display was not good enough, and that there must be an improvement defensively. ‘It was tough,' the 23-year-old explained. 'First of all, conceding from a set-piece isn’t the best, and then we tried to push and maybe over-exposed ourselves and played some passes we shouldn’t and forced it. 'I feel we needed to relax and not push too hard for the equaliser; we needed to believe it would come if we continued playing our football. But I think we pushed too hard to get it and they hurt us on the counter. 'They get the second goal and then the third goal really hit home and hurt. The second half we weren’t good enough, obviously, and we’ve got a lot to work on during the international break.' For the first time under Xabi Alonso – and the first time this season in all competitions – the Blues failed to find the net. Joao Pedro was also absent due to injury, with the Brazilian replaced by Danny Welbeck, who netted in our previous two Carabao Cup fixtures, in the side. Yet Colwill insisted that, no matter who is deployed in attack, a solid defence is required to give us a platform to win games. He said: 'We can’t rely on the front three to pull us out of danger; the rest of us have to try to help as much as possible. The defence, the midfield and the attackers, we all need to help each other much more. 'We’ve definitely got a lot of room to improve.'
news.body_zh: 在我们0-3输给布伦特福德后，利瓦伊·科尔威尔在承担赛后媒体职责时，脸上写满了失望。正如我们当晚的队长所承认的那样，这个结果令人痛苦。最终比分并不一定反映切尔西在 Gtech 社区体育场的表现。我们控制了开局的大部分时间，尽管有大量的长界外球，但限制了布伦特福德只有一脚射中目标。我们自己创造了几次机会，曹伊欣·凯莱赫挡出了佩德罗·内托和摩根·罗杰斯的射门，后者在上半场最后时刻的射门也被挡出。下半场，随着球员们陆续登场，比赛陷入了微妙的平衡。不幸的是，它改变了东道主的方式。一小时后杰登·安东尼头球破门，伊戈尔·蒂亚戈进球，法比奥·卡瓦略在补时阶段为布伦特福德的胜利锦上添花。对于蓝军来说，这是一个令人失望的夜晚。科尔威尔在里斯·詹姆斯因伤缺席期间担任球队队长，他对球队的表现诚实地进行了反思。他承认下半场的表现不够好，防守方面必须有所改进。 “这很艰难，”23 岁的他解释道。 “首先，定位球丢球并不是最好的，然后我们试图逼抢，也许过度暴露了自己，并传出了一些我们不应该传球的传球，并强迫传球。 “我觉得我们需要放松，不要太用力去扳平比分；我们需要相信，如果我们继续踢足球，它就会到来。但我认为我们太努力了，他们在柜台上伤害了我们。 “他们进了第二个球，然后第三个球真的击中了要害并伤害了他们。显然，下半场我们表现得不够好，在国际比赛日期间我们还有很多工作要做。”在哈维·阿隆索的带领下，蓝军第一次未能进球，这也是本赛季在所有比赛中第一次。若奥·佩德罗也因伤缺席，巴西人被丹尼·维尔贝克顶替，他在我们之前两场卡拉宝杯比赛中进球。但科尔威尔坚持认为，无论谁在进攻中部署，都需要坚实的防守才能为我们提供赢得比赛的平台。他说：“我们不能依靠前三名来把我们从危险中拉出来；我们其他人必须尽力提供​​帮助。后防线、中场和前锋，我们都需要更多地互相帮助。 “我们肯定还有很大的改进空间。”

news.title: Alonso: ‘It’s not about talking or looking for excuses’
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：“这不是谈论或寻找借口”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso felt his Chelsea team were punished for not being able to maintain the required levels to compete against Brentford over the course of 90 minutes, with our manager stressing he is not ‘looking for excuses’ for the defeat. The Blues were the better team before the interval, but the Bees took charge in the second period and broke the deadlock through Jaidon Anthony on the hour. We tried to muster a response, yet our hosts made sure of the result with two late goals, leaving Alonso to reflect on a second defeat so far this season. ‘I’m disappointed at the end with the second half and the result,’ he said. ‘This is not enough to compete in the Premier League, not to be able to go for the 90 minutes. This is why today we were punished. ‘At the moment, we are not being consistent enough to compete during the whole game – 45 [minutes] is not enough, you need to play the whole game knowing each detail is important and each action can be decisive. ‘We dropped our consistency, and our competitive mentality needed in the second half. It's about 95 minutes, and we have not been able to keep that level throughout these few games in the start of the season. It's something that we'll have to do better.’ Alonso had to make do without his captain, Reece James, and arguably our top performer so far this season, Joao Pedro. Both were ruled out because of injury. But our manager was at pains to not use the duo’s absence to explain away the result at the Gtech Community Stadium. ‘It’s not about talking or looking for excuses,’ said Alonso. ‘We need to look at each other and know we have to work and improve. 'There is still a long way to go, but we have to check many things.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索认为他的切尔西队因无法在 90 分钟内保持与布伦特福德的比赛所需的水平而受到惩罚，我们的主教练强调他并没有为失败“寻找借口”。蓝军在中场休息前表现更好，但蜜蜂队在第二节占据主导地位，并在比赛结束时通过杰登·安东尼打破了僵局。我们试图做出回应，但我们的东道主在最后时刻的两个进球确保了结果，让阿隆索反思了本赛季迄今为止的第二场失利。 “我对下半场的结束和结果感到失望，”他说。 “这不足以参加英超联赛，无法踢满 90 分钟。这就是今天我们受到惩罚的原因。 “目前，我们在整场比赛中的稳定性还不够——45分钟是不够的，你需要打整场比赛，知道每个细节都很重要，每个动作都具有决定性。” “我们失去了稳定性，也失去了下半场所需的竞争心态。大约是95分钟，我们在赛季初的这几场比赛中都没能保持这个水平。这是我们必须做得更好的事情。”阿隆索不得不在没有他的队长里斯·詹姆斯和可以说是我们本赛季迄今为止表现最好的球员若昂·佩德罗的情况下生存。两人均因伤缺席。但我们的经理煞费苦心地不利用两人的缺席来解释 Gtech 社区体育场的结果。 “这不是谈论或寻找借口，”阿隆索说。 “我们需要互相审视，知道我们必须努力并改进。 “还有很长的路要走，但我们必须检查很多事情。”

news.title: Match report: Brentford 3-0 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：布伦特福德 3-0 切尔西
news.body_en: Three second-half goals condemned Chelsea to defeat at the Gtech Community Stadium in our final fixture before the international break. Chelsea were the better side in the opening 45 minutes, with Pedro Neto drawing an excellent save from Caoimhin Kelleher and Morgan Rogers having a goalbound shot blocked. However, it was Brentford who came out the blocks faster following the interval and they scored what felt like it would be a pivotal opener through Jaidon Anthony’s close-range header on the hour. As we pressed for an equaliser, we were caught on the break late on. Igor Thiago doubled the Bees lead and Fabio Carvalho made it 3-0 with virtually the last kick, condemning us to a first defeat at the Gtech Community Stadium. Xabi Alonso made five alterations to his side, handing Jordan Henderson a Chelsea debut and three other players their first start in the Premier League. Pep Chavarria, Valentin Barco, and Danny Welbeck were all included in the XI, with Maxence Lacroix the other fresh face in the side. Two of the changes were enforced, with Reece James and Joao Pedro unavailable, while Malo Gusto, Jorrel Hato and Romeo Lavia dropped to the bench. They were joined there by 16-year-old Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli, who was named in a matchday squad for the first time and would come on to make his Blues debut. A crackling Friday night atmosphere greeted the teams and after a brief spell of Brentford pressure, we began to assert our dominance on the contest. Cole Palmer danced his way into the box but was eventually crowded out before he could shoot. Chavarria was a regular outlet down our left and from one cross in the tenth minute, Welbeck teed up Pedro Neto. His first-time shot was well saved by Kelleher. By the midway point of the half, we had limited the home side’s threat to a handful of set-pieces and long throws, passing the test on every occasion. The Blues were mixing up our attacks, using width on occasion but also allowing Rogers to drift infield and link up with Palmer. It was from a central position that our no.17’s goalbound shot – from Chavarria’s intelligent pass – hit Jannik Schuster and fizzed behind. It had not been an opening 45 minutes full of opportunities, but this unfamiliar Chelsea side could certainly be satisfied with their efforts as the teams headed down the tunnel with it all still to play for. The second half started in similar fashion: keenly contested, but with space in the final third at a premium. Brentford improved, too, and five minutes in, Emi Martinez got the feintest of touches on an Anthony header that hit the top of the crossbar, but the offside flag was up anyway. Not long after, our keeper launched a counter-attack with a diagonal pass that Chavarria latched on to. He opted to shoot and though Kelleher was worried, the ball flew wide. Brentford went straight up the other end and scored. Damsgaard’s corner from the left was met by Schuster, who headed back across goal for an unmarked Anthony to nod into the net from a couple of yards out. We very nearly levelled matters up from a corner of our own. Henderson’s vicious delivery was missed by Kelleher but the ricochet didn’t quite land in our favour, with the Bees smuggling the ball clear. Our hosts twice looked threatening on the break but couldn’t make the most of their men over, and then we really started to ramp up the pressure, pinning Brentford back and winning corner after corner. From one, Barco had a good appeal for a penalty waved away, with his attempt one of several in quick succession that were met by a red-and-white shirt flinging themselves in the line of fire. We had five shots blocked between the 66th and the 80th minute. But it was Brentford who got the game’s second goal. Schade was set free and though Martinez did excellently to save his shot, the rebound fell to Thiago who couldn’t miss. Alonso brought Nicoll-Jazuli on for his senior debut late on, and there was still time for Brentford to extend their lead, Carvalho firing home at the far post after Schade’s cross had been deflected kindly into his path. The Blues remain on seven points with five league games played. A prolonged international break that lasts until the second week of October. We return to action on Saturday 10 October when Bournemouth come to the Bridge. Chelsea (4-2-3-1): Martinez; Fofana (Acheampong 71), Lacroix, Colwill (c), Chavarria; Henderson, Barco (Nicoll-Jazuli 87); Neto (Estevao 87), Palmer, Rogers; Welbeck (Quenda 71) Unused subs: Penders, Gusto, Hato, Lavia, Gittens Brentford (4-3-3): Kelleher; Kayode (Hickey 69), Ajer, Schuster, Lewis-Potter (Diouf 81); Yarmoliuk (Sangare 69), Janelt (c), Damsgaard (Carvalho 87); Anthony (Ouattara 81), Thiago, SchadeUnused subs: Balcombe, Henry, Wilson, FredrickScorers: Anthony 61, Thiago 83, Carvalho 90+4 Booked: Thiago 84, Sangare 85 Referee Andrew Madley Crowd 17,193
news.body_zh: 下半场的三个进球让切尔西在国际比赛日之前的最后一场比赛中在 Gtech 社区体育场失利。开场 45 分钟，切尔西表现较好，佩德罗·内托 (Pedro Neto) 精彩扑救考伊欣·凯莱赫 (Caoimhin Kelleher)，摩根·罗杰斯 (Morgan Rogers) 的射门被挡出。然而，布伦特福德在中场休息后更快地完成了拦网，他们通过杰登·安东尼(Jaidon Anthony)的近距离头球破门得分，感觉这将是一个关键的揭幕战。当我们力争扳平比分时，我们在中场休息时陷入了困境。伊戈尔·蒂亚戈 (Igor Thiago) 扩大了蜜蜂队的领先优势，而法比奥·卡瓦略 (Fabio Carvalho) 在最后一脚将比分改写为 3-0，这让我们在 Gtech 社区体育场遭遇了首场失利。哈维·阿隆索对球队进行了五次调整，乔丹·亨德森在切尔西首次亮相，其他三名球员则在英超联赛中首次首发。佩普·查瓦里亚、瓦伦丁·巴科和丹尼·维尔贝克都入选了首发阵容，马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦是另一位新面孔。其中两项调整被强制执行，里斯·詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗无法上场，而马洛·古斯托、乔雷尔·哈托和罗密欧·拉维亚则坐在替补席上。 16 岁的迈赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利 (Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli) 也加入了他们的行列，他首次入选比赛日大名单，并在上场后首次亮相蓝军。星期五晚上，各支球队的气氛热烈，在短暂的布伦特福德压力之后，我们开始确立我们在比赛中的统治地位。科尔·帕尔默跳进禁区，但最终在射门之前就被挤了出去。查瓦里亚是我们左路的常规出路，第十分钟的一次传中，维尔贝克将佩德罗·内托送入球门。他的第一次射门被凯莱赫成功扑出。到半场中段时，我们将主队的威胁限制在少量的定位球和长传上，每次都通过了考验。蓝军混合了我们的进攻，有时使用宽度，但也让罗杰斯漂移到内场并与帕尔默联系。我们的 17 号球员从中间位置射门——查瓦里亚巧妙的传球——击中了扬尼克·舒斯特尔并在身后嘶嘶作响。开场的 45 分钟并不是充满机会的，但这支陌生的切尔西队肯定会对自己的努力感到满意，因为球队即将进入隧道，一切仍有待争夺。下半场以类似的方式开始：争夺激烈，但最后三分之一的空间非常宝贵。布伦特福德也有所进步，五分钟后，埃米·马丁内斯接到安东尼的头球击中横梁顶部，但越位旗还是举了起来。不久之后，我们的门将发起反击，斜传球被查瓦里亚接住。他选择射门，尽管凯莱赫很担心，但球飞出了边线。布伦特福德直接冲上另一端得分。达姆斯加德从左侧开出角球，舒斯特尔接到球门后回传球，无人盯防的安东尼在几码外头球入网。我们差点就从自己的一个角落里把事情搞平了。亨德森的恶毒传球被凯莱赫错过，但跳弹并没有完全对我们有利，蜜蜂队将球偷偷清除。我们的东道主两次在中场休息时看起来很有威胁，但无法充分利用他们的球员，然后我们开始加大压力，将布伦特福德压制住，赢得一个又一个角球。从一开始，巴科就曾多次提出点球请求，但被判无效，他连续几次尝试都被红白相间的球衣扔进了火线中，这是他的一次尝试。从第 66 分钟到第 80 分钟，我们有 5 次射门被挡出。但布伦特福德打进了比赛的第二个进球。沙德被释放，尽管马丁内斯出色地扑出了射门，但篮板球落到了蒂亚戈身上，蒂亚戈投篮不中。阿隆索在晚些时候让尼科尔-贾祖利上场，完成了他的成年队首秀，布伦特福德还有时间扩大领先优势，在沙德的传中被巧妙地偏转到他的路径上后，卡瓦略在远门柱射门。蓝军在进行了五场联赛后仍积七分。长期的国际假期将持续到十月的第二周。 10 月 10 日星期六，伯恩茅斯将造访蓝桥，我们将重返赛场。 切尔西（4-2-3-1）：马丁内斯；福法纳（Acheampong 71）、拉克鲁瓦、科尔威尔（c）、查瓦里亚；亨德森，巴可（Nicoll-Jazuli 87）；内托 (Estevao 87)、帕尔默、罗杰斯；维尔贝克 (Quenda 71) 未上场替补：彭德斯、古斯托、哈托、拉维亚、吉滕斯 布伦特福德 (4-3-3)：凯莱赫；卡约德（希基 69）、阿耶尔、舒斯特、刘易斯-波特（迪乌夫 81）；亚莫柳克 (Sangare 69)、贾内特 (c)、达姆斯加德 (Carvalho 87)；安东尼（瓦塔拉 81）、蒂亚戈、沙德未使用替补：巴尔科姆、亨​​利、威尔逊、弗雷德里克得分手：安东尼 61、蒂亚戈 83、卡瓦略 90+4 黄牌：蒂亚戈 84、桑加雷 85 裁判安德鲁·马德利·克劳德 17,193

news.title: Xabi Alonso on 'competitive monster' Jordan Henderson and Chelsea absentees
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索谈“竞争怪物”乔丹·亨德森和切尔西的缺席
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has described Jordan Henderson as a 'competitive monster' after handing the midfielder his Chelsea debut at Brentford and explained why Reece James and Joao Pedro are absent this evening. Henderson joined the Blues on a free transfer this summer, but his Blues bow has been delayed due to the broken arm he sustained while away with England at this summer's FIFA World Cup. The 36-year-old has diligently undertaken his recovery at Cobham over the past six weeks and is now ready to make his Chelsea debut – and it comes against the club with whom he spent the previous campaign. On including Henderson in his side against Brentford, Alonso said: ‘The Premier League is about competing and Jordan is a competitive monster. 'I’m sure he will help the team with his quality, his game intelligence and the communication he has. We’re happy to have him back.' Alonso has been unable to call upon several players at the Gtech Community Stadium, with James and Joao Pedro joining Marco Palestra, Moises Caicedo and Emmanuel Emegha on the sidelines. 'Reece picked up a little injury in the last game against Hull and was feeling short in his recovery,' Alonso explained ahead of tonight's game. 'Joao we tried, but we expect to use the international break for him to be back in the next game against Bournemouth.' The Brazilian's absence means Danny Welbeck makes his full Premier League debut for the Blues, and will form part of an attack that includes Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers. 'You need to adapt to the qualities of the players and get the benefit of what they do well,' Alonso explained when asked what Welbeck will offer as part of our front three. 'We know Danny is a reference and links very well. He is intelligent and knows where to play, and if we have a front three that works well it will be better for the team.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在乔丹·亨德森在布伦特福德完成切尔西首秀后将其描述为“有竞争力的怪物”，并解释了里斯·詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗今晚缺席的原因。亨德森今年夏天免费转会加盟蓝军，但由于他在今年夏天随英格兰队参加世界杯时手臂骨折，他的蓝军出场时间被推迟。过去六周里，这位 36 岁的球员在科巴姆努力康复，现在已经准备好在切尔西首次亮相，而且对手是他上赛季效力的俱乐部。在将亨德森纳入球队对阵布伦特福德的比赛中，阿隆索表示：“英超联赛就是竞争，而乔丹是一个有竞争力的怪物。 “我相信他会凭借自己的能力、比赛智慧和沟通能力为球队提供帮助。我们很高兴他回来了。”阿隆索无法在 Gtech 社区体育场召唤几名球员，詹姆斯和若昂·佩德罗加入了马科·帕莱斯特拉、莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和伊曼纽尔·埃梅加的行列。 “里斯在上一场对阵赫尔城的比赛中受了点伤，感觉恢复时间很短，”阿隆索在今晚的比赛前解释道。 “我们尝试过若奥，但我们希望利用国际比赛日让他在下一场对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中回归。”巴西人的缺席意味着丹尼·维尔贝克将在蓝军的英超联赛中首次亮相，并将成为包括科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯在内的进攻的一部分。当被问及维尔贝克作为我们的前三名球员将提供什么时，阿隆索解释道：“你需要适应球员的素质，并从他们的出色表现中获益。” “我们知道丹尼是一个参考，并且联系非常好。他很聪明，知道在哪里踢球，如果我们有一个运转良好的前场三人组，那对球队来说会更好。”

news.title: Jordan Henderson on making his Chelsea debut at Brentford
news.title_zh: 乔丹·亨德森在布伦特福德完成切尔西首秀
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson has had to wait patiently to make his Chelsea debut. But having recovered from injury, the 36-year-old is in from the start against Brentford tonight and ready to make his mark. Henderson, who spent last season with the Bees, signed for the Blues earlier in the summer on a free transfer. However, having broken his arm while away with England at the FIFA World Cup, his first outing in Blue has been delayed. Tonight at the Gtech Community Stadium, Henderson will step out in a Chelsea shirt for the first time. And the midfielder is looking forward to introducing himself to the Blues faithful. 'Delighted to be back and have the feeling of getting onto the pitch,' Henderson explained ahead of this evening's Premier League clash with Brentford. 'It’s been a while, so I’m just excited to be back. 'It’s been a little frustrating [not being able to play], but I’ve tried to stay as fit as I can to be ready for this opportunity now. I’m just looking forward to it. 'It’s been good to settle in with the team over the last month, even though it’s been frustrating not playing games, but hopefully now I can get involved.' Henderson's illustrious career has seen him play hundreds of games at domestic level, in England and abroad. His last 34 came with Brentford during the 2025/26 campaign, with the England international impressing for the Bees before his departure and eventual switch to Stamford Bridge. It means that Henderson is well-versed in the threat Keith Andrews' side will pose tonight, and has outlined that the Blues will need to perform well to come away with a positive result. He said: 'They’re a fantastic team who can play with the ball, are good on transition and are good in behind. So it will be a very difficult game, as we know, so we’ve got to be 100 per cent to get anything from the game. 'But if we can play the way we know we can, we will cause them problems as well.'
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森必须耐心等待才能完成他的切尔西首秀。但从伤病中恢复后，这位 36 岁的球员在今晚对阵布伦特福德的比赛中首发出场，并准备好留下自己的印记。亨德森上赛季效力于蜜蜂队，今年夏天早些时候以免费转会的方式加盟蓝军。然而，由于他在随英格兰队参加世界杯时摔断了手臂，他在蓝色队的首场比赛被推迟了。今晚在 Gtech 社区体育场，亨德森将首次身着切尔西球衣出场。这位中场球员期待着向蓝军球迷介绍自己。 “很高兴能回来并有上场的感觉，”亨德森在今晚与布伦特福德的英超比赛前解释道。 “已经有一段时间了，所以我很高兴能回来。 “（无法上场）有点令人沮丧，但我已经尽力保持健康，为现在的机会做好准备。我只是期待它。 “过去一个月适应球队的感觉很好，尽管不参加比赛很令人沮丧，但希望现在我能参与其中。”亨德森辉煌的职业生涯见证了他在国内、英格兰和国外踢了数百场比赛。他的最后34场比赛是在2025/26赛季为布伦特福德效力的，这位英格兰国脚在离开并最终转投斯坦福桥之前为蜜蜂队留下了深刻的印象。这意味着亨德森深知基思·安德鲁斯的球队今晚将构成的威胁，并概述了蓝军需要表现出色才能取得积极的结果。他说：“他们是一支出色的球队，能够控球，擅长攻防转换，也擅长后卫。因此，正如我们所知，这将是一场非常困难的比赛，所以我们必须百分百努力才能从比赛中获得任何东西。 “但如果我们能按照我们知道的方式打球，我们也会给他们带来麻烦。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Brentford
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵布伦特福德的阵容
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made five changes to his Chelsea team for today’s fixture away to Brentford, with a quartet of Blues handed their full Premier League debut. Pep Chavarria, Valentin Barco, Jordan Henderson and Danny Welbeck are included in Alonso’s starting XI. Reece James and Joao Pedro are unavailable, while Malo Gusto, Jorrel Hato and Romeo Lavia drop to the bench. The other new face in the side from last weekend’s draw with Hull City is Maxence Lacroix, while Henderson's selection means he makes his Blues debut against the club he represented last season. The bench includes 16-year-old Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli for the first time in a competitive game. news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Birmingham City press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在伯明翰城赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash with Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge, and here are the standout talking points from her press conference After a resounding 5-0 victory against Manchester United last Sunday, the head coach discussed the importance of a killer mindset, the strengths of our next opponents and her enjoyment of her role as Chelsea head coach. She also went into detail on the role of right wing-back Ellie Carpenter in the side and discussed what will be her 200th game as a manager on Saturday. 'I'm still having a great experience at Chelsea, and I'm loving every moment because I'm really passionate. 'After 200 games as a manager, I feel even more confident and more mature in terms of the way I manage the squad and my decisions every day. Every player and every manager comes to this league because they want to be challenged – that's also why I came here. 'I probably could have stayed longer in France and been more comfortable with winning more games, with not having maybe as much opposition, but that's not who I am. I want to be challenged. I want to find solutions when it's difficult, and this league is really good for that reason.' 'I've been talking a lot about mentality and mindsets. I think every team in this league has a lot of quality, really good individuals, but what sometimes makes the difference is your mentality and your mindset coming into training sessions every day and coming into the games. 'This mentality to want to hurt the team when you are playing against them makes the difference between having good players and the best players in the world. The main difference between our first game and the second was the intensity and the mindset we played with in the Man United game; I think it was quite clear. 'Coaching that is not always easy, but that's my job, and we are focusing on that a lot because I think we have enough quality in this team, so it's making sure we always bring the intensity into our games, but also the right mindset.' 'I think Ellie is a player who can play different positions in different systems. Right now, we are using her more as a right wing-back. That position gives her maybe a little bit more freedom because she knows she has players behind her who are defending, and we are keeping a better balance in the team. 'A lot of spaces were in that corridor during the last two games we played in, so that's why we were attacking that side. She has the ability to hurt teams in the space in behind the back line. 'She's quick, her ability with the ball is also improving a lot, and she's able to have really good crosses. She's able to score great goals when she comes into that position in the box. So that's something we are trying to use a lot because it's working, but we also have the opportunity to do that on the left side with Alyssa Thompson. 'She's also a really good profile for us to use and to, again, use the speed of them both behind the back line. So, yeah, we'll see.' 'They have the ability, with individuals and as a team, to have a lot of quality in terms of the defensive aspects, but also hurting teams in different ways. They are really well organised defensively as well. 'I watched their first two games and some of the games in preseason for Birmingham, and they have a lot of quality. Even if they lost their first game, the performances were good. So we need to be at our best tomorrow.' 'First and foremost, when you have some injuries and players are not available, you need to have this versatility. You need to find solutions when you are a manager. 'So I think it's good for me as a coach to sometimes talk to the players about being able to play in different positions, but also in terms of tactics, trying to help them understand different positions. So you do that a lot with the young players in the academy, but also in the first team at Chelsea with the young ones. 'I think we are lucky enough to also have experienced players who can play multiple positions, and it's good, especially when you get injuries, so you can still try to manage and find the right solutions to win the game.' Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在斯坦福桥对阵伯明翰城的女足超级联赛之前在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是她在新闻发布会上的精彩谈话要点。在上周日以 5-0 战胜曼联后，主教练讨论了杀手心态的重要性、我们下一个对手的优势以及她对切尔西主教练角色的享受。她还详细介绍了右后卫艾莉·卡彭特在球队中的角色，并讨论了周六她作为主教练的第 200 场比赛。 “我在切尔西仍然拥有美好的经历，我热爱每一刻，因为我真的充满激情。 “作为一名主教练，参加了 200 场比赛之后，我在管理球队的方式和每天的决定方面变得更加自信、更加成熟。每个球员和每个教练来到这个联盟都是因为他们想要接受挑战——这也是我来到这里的原因。 “我可能可以在法国呆更长时间，并且更愿意赢得更多比赛，而不会遇到那么多的反对，但这不是我。我想受到挑战。我想在遇到困难时找到解决方案，因此这个联盟真的很棒。” “我一直在谈论很多关于心态和心态的问题。我认为这个联盟中的每支球队都有很多优秀的球员，但有时真正重要的是你的心态以及每天训练和比赛时的心态。 “当你与球队比赛时，这种想要伤害球队的心态决定了拥有优秀球员和世界上最好球员之间的区别。我们的第一场比赛和第二场比赛的主要区别在于我们在对阵曼联的比赛中的强度和心态；我想这已经很清楚了。 “教练并不总是那么容易，但这是我的工作，我们非常关注这一点，因为我认为我们这支球队有足够的素质，所以它确保我们始终将强度带入我们的比赛，但也有正确的心态。” “我认为埃莉是一位可以在不同体系中打不同位置的球员。现在，我们更多地使用她作为右翼后卫。这个位置可能给了她更多的自由，因为她知道她身后有防守的球员，而我们在球队中保持了更好的平衡。 “在我们参加的最后两场比赛中，走廊里有很多空间，所以这就是我们攻击那一侧的原因。她有能力在后防线的空间内伤害球队。 “她速度很快，控球能力也有了很大提高，而且她能够传出非常好的传中。当她进入禁区的那个位置时，她能够打进精彩的进球。所以这是我们经常尝试使用的东西，因为它很有效，但我们也有机会在左边与艾莉莎·汤普森一起做到这一点。 “她对我们来说也是一个非常好的侧身，可以再次利用她们在后线的速度。所以，是的，我们拭目以待。 “无论是个人还是团队，他们都有能力在防守方面表现出色，但也会以不同的方式伤害球队。他们的防守也组织得很好。 “我观看了他们的前两场比赛以及伯明翰季前赛的一些比赛，他们的实力很高。尽管第一场比赛他们输了，但他们的表现还是不错的。所以明天我们需要保持最佳状态。” “首先也是最重要的，当你受伤并且球员无法上场时，你需要具备这种多功能性。当你是管理者时，你需要找到解决方案。 “所以我认为作为一名教练，有时与球员谈论能够踢不同的位置以及战术方面的事情对我来说是有好处的，试图帮助他们理解不同的位置。所以你在青训营里经常对年轻球员这样做，而且在切尔西一线队也对年轻球员这样做。 “我认为我们很幸运，拥有经验丰富的球员，可以打多个位置，这很好，特别是当你受伤的时候，所以你仍然可以尝试管理并找到正确的解决方案来赢得比赛。”不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.body_en: The ticket selling information has been announced for our final fixture of next month. Chelsea host Manchester United in a Premier League encounter on Saturday 31 October with a 12:30pm kick-off at Stamford Bridge. Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Please note: Loyalty points accrued so far this season will be applied to this fixture. To be successful in this ticket application window, fans will be required to have 9 loyalty points or more. Only supporters who are eligible willshow to be selectable in the application process. A list of all the loyalty points that could be accrued so far this season is available at the bottom of this page. Ticket application window opens – Monday 21 September 12pm Ticket application window closes – Thursday 24 September 12pm The ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category AA. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive one loyalty point for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Monday 21 September 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Thursday 24 September 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Thursday 1 October. You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the official ticketing portal. The sales information on the buy tickets pagewill be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window, who met the loyalty points criteria for this fixture, will have a ticket exchange priority period. These supporters will be notified via email that the priority window is open. A further announcement will be made on the buy tickets page to confirm when the ticket exchange is open to all members. The all on-sale dates page available by clicking here will also be updated. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. news.title: Sonia Bompastor delivers positive injury update on key trio
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 公布了关键三人组的积极伤病情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed that Nathalie Bjorn, Naomi Girma and Melvine Malard will all be available for selection when we take on Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea host the newly-promoted side tomorrow afternoon, with kick off scheduled for 12.45pm, and Bompastor will have extra resources to call upon. Bjorn was named on the substitutes' bench for our 5-0 win against Manchester United last weekend, but did not feature. Meanwhile, Girma and Malard were not in the squad. However, Bompastor says each of the trio is in contention to feature this time around. 'Nay is back in the group and will be with the group tomorrow for the game,' confirmed the Blues boss. 'Nat Bjorn is back, and Melvine Malard is also back in the squad. 'It's really important, really good and positive, especially as we are going to enter a period of three games in a week and six games in the next two weeks. 'It's really important to have as many players available as possible because I think if you want to maintain the intensity, you need to be able to rotate and have some fresh legs coming into every game.' Mayra Ramirez has also been absent from the squad in recent weeks and Bompastor gave an update on her availability too. 'Mayra is back in Colombia for personal reasons,' Bompastor explained. 'The club is supporting her in the best way possible and we are hoping to see her back with the squad and with the team soon.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特确认，当我们在斯坦福桥迎战伯明翰城时，纳塔莉·比约恩、娜奥米·吉尔玛和梅尔文·马拉德都将可供选择。明天下午，切尔西将迎战升班马，开球时间定于中午 12 点 45 分，邦帕斯托将拥有额外的资源可供调用。上周末我们5-0战胜曼联的比赛中，比约恩被列入替补席，但他没有出场。与此同时，吉尔玛和马拉德并不在球队中。然而，邦帕斯特表示，这一次三人组都在争夺出场机会。蓝军主帅证实，“奈伊已经回到了球队，并将与球队一起参加明天的比赛。”纳特·比约恩回来了，梅尔文·马拉德也回到了球队。 “这真的很重要，真的很好，很积极，特别是我们将进入一周三场比赛和接下来两周六场比赛的时期。 “拥有尽可能多的球员非常重要，因为我认为如果你想保持强度，你需要能够轮换并在每场比赛中都有一些新鲜的球员。”最近几周，梅拉·拉米雷斯也缺席了球队，邦帕斯特也更新了她的可用情况。 “梅拉出于个人原因回到了哥伦比亚，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “俱乐部正在以最好的方式支持她，我们希望看到她很快回到球队和球队中。”

news.title: Make it a Blue Day when CFCW take on Arsenal!

news.body_en: Stamford Bridge will host a blockbuster at the end of this month when Chelsea Women go up against the Gunners, and there are plenty of opportunities for Blues fans to play your part. The game between the two most successful clubs in the WSL era, the biggest London derby in women’s football, takes place at 4.30pm on Sunday 27 September, during the break for international fixtures for the men’s team. - Buy your tickets for the big match here We are declaring it a Blue Day and to celebrate the occasion and show your support for the team, those at the Bridge can: Head to the Fan Zone at the Tea Bar for blue face painting, fun activities and live music. Pick up your Blue Day collectable patch to remember the afternoon by. If you are in the West Lower, join in making a mosaic by raising a card placed on your seat above your head as the teams walk out ahead of kick-off. Instructions will be outlined on the cards, and please do not swap cards with those around you. Look out for blue activities around the ground. Remember to bring your scarf and make sure to wave the flag on your seat to turn the Bridge into a sea of blue. Be in the stadium early for our full Blue Day-themed countdown to kick-off, featuring your favourite Blues anthems, our 'How blue are you?' crowd cam, and lots more to get the atmosphere rocking as we build up to the big match. Wear as much blue as possible. Our online store is a great place to start to make that happen. In the words of the famous Chelsea anthem, ‘We're gonna make this a Blue Day’, so please join in the fun and we’ll see you at the Bridge for the derby!

news.title: Alonso on Welbeck’s smooth adaptation and Henderson value
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈维尔贝克的顺利适应和亨德森的价值
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has praised Danny Welbeck's immediate impact at Chelsea and highlighted the vital experience Jordan Henderson has brought to the Blues squad ahead of today’s Premier League clash at Brentford. Welbeck arrived at Stamford Bridge this summer from Brighton and Hove Albion to reinforce our frontline and add expertise from his many years playing in the Premier League. It is apparent from the words of his Chelsea team-mates that the 35-year-old has integrated seamlessly into the group off the pitch. On it, Welbeck has shown encouraging signs in his early appearances, which have included goals in both of our Carabao Cup fixtures so far. There is the possibility of Welbeck making his full Premier League debut for the Blues this evening at the Gtech Stadium. That is a decision for Alonso to make, but the Spaniard has been pleased with the striker's smooth adjustment to life at the Bridge ‘He has adapted very well,’ said Alonso. ‘There was no doubt about that. He has connected very well with the team. He knows what he has to do. ‘He has started a couple of games in the Carabao Cup, and the other day he was close to scoring one goal, so yeah, we are happy with Danny.’ With a demanding fixture list across multiple competitions, Alonso reiterated that every Chelsea player, including Welbeck, must remain prepared to step up when called upon. ‘It's about having a complete squad and about knowing that everyone is ready to play whenever they’re needed,’ he added. ‘You have to be ready. This is professional football, and you need to know when you are in, you need to perform.’ Our third consecutive London away game this season takes us to Henderson's previous home. The midfielder is yet to make his Blues bow following the arm injury he suffered at this summer’s World Cup, but Alonso has not ruled out the possibility of the 36-year-old featuring against his former club tonight. And our manager provided background on the reasons behind Henderson's signing in the summer: chiefly his ability to elevate standards on and off the ball. ‘We analysed it and we wanted to have a good balance between maturity, between experience, between talent, between energy. We have taken a step forward, and we have improved, I think, in that part. ‘Jordan has played an important role being a midfielder, with the impact that he can have with other players, but he has this quality and this personality to improve and to help other players as well. ‘We wanted to have a good balance and people who could add value for what they do and what could improve the other ones, and Jordan does it very well.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索赞扬了丹尼·维尔贝克对切尔西的直接影响，并强调了乔丹·亨德森在今天布伦特福德的英超比赛之前为蓝军队带来的重要经验。维尔贝克今年夏天从布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩来到斯坦福桥，以加强我们的锋线并补充他在英超联赛中多年踢球的专业知识。从切尔西队友的话语中可以明显看出，这位35岁的球员在场外已经无缝地融入了球队。在这方面，维尔贝克在他的早期出场中表现出了令人鼓舞的迹象，其中包括迄今为止我们在卡拉宝杯的两场比赛中的进球。维尔贝克有可能今晚在 Gtech 体育场完成他为蓝军完成的英超首秀。这是阿隆索要做的决定，但西班牙人对前锋顺利适应蓝桥生活感到满意。“他适应得很好，”阿隆索说。 ” “这一点毫无疑问。他与球队的联系非常好。他知道他必须做什么。 “他在卡拉宝杯中首发了几场比赛，有一天他差点就打进一球，所以是的，我们对丹尼感到满意。”由于多场比赛的赛程要求很高，阿隆索重申，包括维尔贝克在内的每一位切尔西球员都必须做好准备，在需要时挺身而出。 “这是关于拥有一支完整的球队，并且知道每个人都已经准备好在需要时参加比赛，”他补充道。 ‘你必须做好准备。这是职业足球，你需要知道什么时候你在场，你需要表现。” 本赛季我们连续第三次在伦敦客场比赛，我们将前往亨德森之前的主场。这位中场球员在今年夏天的世界杯上手臂受伤后，尚未代表蓝军出场，但阿隆索并未排除这位36岁的球员今晚在对阵老东家的比赛中出场的可能性。我们的经理提供了亨德森夏季签约原因的背景：主要是他提高有球和无球水平的能力。 “我们对其进行了分析，我们希望在成熟度、经验、天赋和精力之间取得良好的平衡。我们已经向前迈出了一步，我认为我们在这方面已经有所进步。 “乔丹作为一名中场球员发挥了重要作用，他可以对其他球员产生影响，但他也有这种品质和个性来提高并帮助其他球员。 “我们希望有一个良好的平衡，人们可以为自己所做的事情增加价值，也可以改进其他人，而乔丹在这方面做得很好。”
