news.title: Romeo Lavia on feeling free, taking responsibility and changing his Chelsea narrative
news.title_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚谈自由、承担责任和改变他的切尔西叙事
news.body_en: Romeo Lavia has thanked his team-mates and the Chelsea coaching staff for helping him overcome adversity and start this season strongly, as he looks to push himself to new levels on the pitch. The midfielder's Chelsea career, by his own admission, has been stop-start. Injuries have made it difficult for the Belgian to find his rhythm at Stamford Bridge, although when fully fit, supporters have seen the qualities he brings to the side. This season, Lavia has started our opening four Premier League fixtures under Xabi Alonso. He has impressed, looked sharp, and helped cover the absence of Moises Caicedo – the Ecuadorian's only minutes this term came as a second-half substitute against Brighton and Hove Albion. It's no surprise, then, that Lavia is feeling confident and has a renewed sense of purpose at Chelsea. He is determined to show everyone what he is truly capable of. ‘This season feels different because I'm in a different…let’s say mindset or space of mind,’ explained Lavia. ‘We've done a lot of work over the summer with all the people at the club to make sure that we could get everything that's happened before behind me. So far it's going well. I'm very happy and long may it continue. ‘To show up under the lights on the weekend is the last part of the puzzle; there is so much that goes on behind the scenes. It's the constant analysing of all the aspects that you want to tick off before being ready to play on the weekend. It's a big process, but we're doing well at the moment. ‘I've learned that you can always go further than you think you can. You can always push your limits, especially when you feel like everything is going against you. It's always so easy to just think about giving up, or think that no matter what you do, it's only going to go back to the same point where you started. ‘Luckily, with the help of my team-mates, the staff, everyone at the club and outside, the people close to me, we've been able to create a sort of bubble where you just concentrate on what you can control, and then everything will come out on top. ‘It's been a little bit stop-start since I've joined, so it's a bit frustrating, but the reason why I'm so excited about what's to come is that, whether it's in training or games, I feel the love from my team-mates. ‘I feel like they trust in me, which is then giving me the confidence to go and express myself without thinking about what's happened. That's something that really helps me.’ That love was evident when Lavia scored his first Chelsea goal earlier this season. He found the net in our 4-3 win over Brighton & Hove Albion at Stamford Bridge, sparking emotional celebrations as the rest of the players rushed to congratulate him in front of the home fans. ‘To be honest, when it first went in, I didn't really believe it because it's just been so long,’ the 22-year-old admits. ‘I had kind of lost that feeling of scoring, but thinking back, it was an amazing feeling. Then, straight away, all my team-mates grabbed me. So it was a very good moment to experience. ‘It was just a moment where I felt free, where it feels like all the work that you're putting in, you're getting the reward for it. It was a very good but very emotional moment at the same time, so I wanted to express it as much as possible with the fans. I really loved it. ‘Especially because I wanted to change the narrative. My first Premier League goal was against Chelsea, so I always felt like it was a bit strange. 'Then I've seen all my team-mates score at Stamford Bridge and the atmosphere that it would create, so I was waiting for it to be my turn. When it happened, I was just very happy and excited.’ Of course, it is for far more than that goal that his team-mates, the supporters and Alonso are so pleased to see Lavia back in the Chelsea midfield, with the quality of his performances this season making it seem like he has never been missing. If he was feeling any pressure to make up for lost time, he certainly hasn’t shown it. ‘Responsibility is something that has always been part of my game as well, to take responsibility and have some character,’ Romeo added. ‘I really like being in that position and also being at this club, having this responsibility. It's not even pressure; it's just like a privilege. So I'm actually living the dream. It's just like: “Okay, this is what you've been playing and training all these years for, so just go and enjoy it.”’
news.body_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚感谢他的队友和切尔西教练组帮助他克服逆境并强势开启本赛季，因为他希望在球场上将自己推向新的水平。这位中场球员自己承认，他在切尔西的职业生涯是断断续续的。伤病让比利时人很难在斯坦福桥找到自己的节奏，尽管在完全康复后，球迷们已经看到了他为球队带来的品质。本赛季，拉维亚在哈维·阿隆索的带领下首发了四场英超联赛。他给人留下了深刻的印象，看起来很敏锐，并帮助弥补了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的缺席——厄瓜多尔人本赛季唯一的上场时间是在对阵布莱顿和霍夫·阿尔比恩的下半场替补出场。因此，拉维亚感到自信并且在切尔西有了新的目标感也就不足为奇了。他决心向所有人展示他真正的能力。 “这个赛季感觉不同，因为我处于不同的……比如说心态或思维空间，”拉维亚解释道。 `整个夏天我们与俱乐部的所有人一起做了很多工作，以确保我们能够把之前发生的一切都抛在脑后。到目前为止一切进展顺利。我很高兴，希望这种情况能够持续下去。 “周末出现在灯光下是这个难题的最后一部分；幕后发生了很多事情。这是在准备周末比赛之前对您想要勾选的所有方面进行不断的分析。这是一个很大的过程，但我们目前做得很好。 “我了解到，你总是可以比你想象的走得更远。你总是可以突破自己的极限，尤其是当你觉得一切都对你不利时。人们总是很容易想到放弃，或者认为无论你做什么，都只会回到你开始的地方。 “幸运的是，在我的队友、工作人员、俱乐部内外的每个人以及我身边的人的帮助下，我们能够创造一种泡沫，让你专注于你能控制的事情，然后一切都会水到渠成。 “自从我加入以来，情况有点停顿，所以有点令人沮丧，但我对即将发生的事情如此兴奋的原因是，无论是在训练还是比赛中，我都能感受到队友们的爱。 “我觉得他们信任我，这让我有信心去表达自己，而不用考虑发生了什么。这对我确实有帮助。”当拉维亚在本赛季早些时候攻入他在切尔西的第一个进球时，这种爱就显而易见了。他在斯坦福桥4-3战胜布莱顿的比赛中攻入进球，引发了激动人心的庆祝活动，其他球员也纷纷在主场球迷面前向他表示祝贺。这位 22 岁的年轻人承认，说实话，当它第一次进入时，我真的不太相信，因为已经过去了太久了。 “我有点失去了进球的感觉，但回想起来，那是一种奇妙的感觉。然后，我所有的队友立刻抓住了我。所以这是一个非常好的体验时刻。 “那一刻我感到自由，感觉你付出的所有努力都得到了回报。这是一个非常美好但又非常激动人心的时刻，所以我想尽可能多地向粉丝们表达这一点。我真的很喜欢它。 “特别是因为我想改变叙述方式。我的第一个英超进球是对阵切尔西的，所以我总觉得这有点奇怪。 “然后我看到了我所有的队友在斯坦福桥进球以及它所营造的氛围，所以我正在等待轮到我的机会。当这一切发生时，我感到非常高兴和兴奋。”当然，他的队友、球迷和阿隆索如此高兴看到拉维亚回到切尔西中场，远不止这个进球，他本赛季的表现让他看起来从未缺席过。如果他感到有任何压力来弥补失去的时间，他肯定没有表现出来。 “责任也一直是我比赛的一部分，承担责任并具有一定的性格，”罗密欧补充道。 “我真的很喜欢担任这个职位，也很喜欢在这个俱乐部，承担这个责任。这甚至不是压力；而是压力。这就像一种特权。所以我实际上正在实现梦想。就像：“好吧，这就是你这些年来一直在打球和训练的目的，所以去享受它吧。”

news.title: Chelsea FC transforms community football pitch in Ecuador
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部改造厄瓜多尔社区足球场
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club has completed the renovation of a community pitch in Guayaquil, Ecuador, as part of our global Can’t Tame Us campaign for the 2026/27 third kit launch, creating a renewed space for football, connection and community in one of the city’s most densely populated neighbourhoods. Located in Guasmo Norte, the futsal pitch is more than a place to play. Set among the homes and everyday life of the neighbourhood, it provides a shared outdoor space where children can kick a ball around, friends can compete, families can watch from the sidelines and neighbours can stop to talk. The renovation gives the community a refreshed place to come together through a shared love of sport, while helping to make football more accessible to the next generation. Click to shop the third kit now Ecuador is the country that gave us Moises Caicedo, the winner of our Men’s Player of the Year for the 2024/25 season, and Kendry Paez who has recently returned from a loan to join our Cobham Next Gen squad. Indeed, Guayaquil is Paez’s home city. The official opening of the pitch took place yesterday, with Ecuadorian singer Javier Neira, known for La Tri, in attendance, performing three songs. Influencers including Anthony Lencina, Camilo Balladares, Francisco Molestina, Israel Vera and Santiago Morales alongside members of the Chelsea family and local residents watched the celebrations as the renewed pitch was unveiled. The Guayaquil renovation is the third community facility to be refurbished this summer as part of Can’t Tame Us, with football’s generational appeal being used to bring communities together and encourage greater participation in the sport. The project follows the launch of facilities in São Paulo and in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, with thousands of fans visiting and using the renewed pitches. Across all three locations, the aim is simple: to create spaces where football can be played, shared and passed from one generation to the next; using the power of the game to bring people together and help communities thrive. Scott Fenton, Brand director at Chelsea FC, said: ‘Ecuador has a special connection with Chelsea and has produced incredible players such as Moises Caicedo, and fantastic talents like Kendry Paez. We want to build on that connection by inspiring and empowering future generations of fans and young footballers, giving them the opportunity to discover their potential, develop their skills and dream big. This community space is an important part of that commitment.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部已经完成了厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔社区球场的翻新工程，这是我们为 2026/27 年第三套球衣发布而推出的全球“不能驯服我们”活动的一部分，为该市人口最稠密的社区之一创造了一个全新的足球、联系和社区空间。五人制足球场位于瓜斯莫北 (Guasmo Norte)，它不仅仅是一个比赛场所。它坐落在社区的家庭和日常生活中，提供了一个共享的户外空间，孩子们可以在这里踢球，朋友可以比赛，家人可以在一旁观看，邻居可以停下来交谈。此次翻修为社区提供了一个焕然一新的场所，让他们通过对体育的共同热爱聚集在一起，同时有助于让下一代更容易接触到足球。点击立即购买第三套球衣 厄瓜多尔为我们提供了 2024/25 赛季年度最佳男子球员得主莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 (Moises Caicedo)，以及最近从租借归来加入我们的科巴姆下一代球队的肯德利·帕兹 (Kendry Paez)。事实上，瓜亚基尔是帕埃斯的家乡。昨天，球场正式开幕，因《La Tri》而闻名的厄瓜多尔歌手哈维尔·内拉出席并演唱了三首歌。包括安东尼·伦西纳、卡米洛·巴拉达雷斯、弗朗西斯科·莫莱斯蒂纳、以色列·维拉和圣地亚哥·莫拉莱斯在内的影响力人士以及切尔西家族成员和当地居民观看了新球场揭幕仪式的庆祝活动。瓜亚基尔翻修工程是今年夏天翻新的第三个社区设施，是“不能驯服我们”项目的一部分，利用足球的代际吸引力将社区聚集在一起，鼓励更多人参与这项运动。该项目是在巴西圣保罗和里约热内卢的设施启动后推出的，成千上万的球迷参观并使用了更新后的球场。这三个地点的目标都很简单：创造可以踢球、分享足球并代代相传的空间；利用游戏的力量将人们聚集在一起并帮助社区蓬勃发展。切尔西足球俱乐部品牌总监斯科特·芬顿表示：“厄瓜多尔与切尔西有着特殊的联系，并培养了像莫伊塞斯·凯塞多这样令人难以置信的球员，以及像肯德利·帕埃斯这样的出色人才。我们希望通过激励和赋权下一代球迷和年轻足球运动员来建立这种联系，让他们有机会发现自己的潜力，发展他们的技能并实现远大的梦想。这个社区空间是这一承诺的重要组成部分。

news.title: Three Women’s Super League matches at the Bridge on sale next week
news.title_zh: 下周在大桥举行的三场女足超级联赛比赛将发售
news.body_en: With the Barclays WSL season now properly underway, three more of this season’s games to be played at Stamford Bridge will have their tickets go on sale on Monday. Sonia Bompastor’s side recorded their first win in this season’s competition last weekend and they did so in style, with a 5-0 win at Manchester United. Tomorrow the Blues return to the Bridge to play Birmingham (tickets are available here) and further on the horizon are three home fixtures in November and December. All are yet to have their dates and kick-off times confirmed but over the weekend of 7 and 8 November we welcome Everton, and the following weekend we take on the team we are aiming to reclaim the league crown from, Manchester City. Those are followed by a derby against London City Lionesses on the weekend of 12/13 December. Ticket sales for these matches will be as follows (supporters can purchase up to 20 tickets per transaction): For all three matches, early-bird tickets will be on sale from 2pm on Monday 21 September. For all three matches, general sale tickets will be on sale from 2pm on Monday 28 September. For the match versus Everton, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 4 November. For the match versus Manchester City, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 11 November. For the match versus London City Lionesses, last chance to buy tickets will be on sale from 12pm on Wednesday 9 December. Supporters who hold a Bridge Pass will not need to purchase tickets for the Manchester City and London City Lionesses games as these fixture are covered in the pass. Tickets will be sold online only and are for Chelsea supporters only. They are initially available to purchase in the entirety of the lower bowl except for the Everton game where they are initially available to purchase in the West lower and Shed lower. Premium tickets are available to purchase by selecting the Pitch View Lounge in blocks 1 and 2 of the Shed Lower. Alcoholic drinks purchased in the stadium will be allowed in all areas of the stadium except the alcohol-free stands in blocks 1 and 2 of the West Lower. Tickets for the Man City and London City Lionesses matches are priced at Category A. For the Everton match they are Category B. Click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with, and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Supporters who require accessible tickets can submit an application form available by clicking here during the selling period. Alternatively, you can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) to reserve tickets and request further information. Personal assistant tickets can only be allocated using this process. Supporters can click here to apply for car parking from 10am on Tuesday 17 October (Everton game), 10am on Tuesday 20 October (Man City game), and 10am on Tuesday 17 November (London City Lionesses). You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. Season ticket holders will be able to list their tickets for select games throughout the season, and the sales information on the Buy Tickets page will be updated if the ticket exchange opens. news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek five
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西第五周比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which of the Blues' players are must-haves, who the best value-for-money picks are, and why Morgan Rogers (£7.7m) is Chelsea’s most popular player this week. Cole Palmer (£9.7m) continues to show consistency, picking up his fourth attacking return of the season in the entertaining 2-2 draw against Hull City in Gameweek 4. Chelsea’s attack has scored a whopping 18 goals in six matches under Xabi Alonso. Our number 10 had three shots on goal and created three chances at Stamford Bridge - no Chelsea player could better that in Gameweek 4. Averaging nearly seven points per match, Cole is currently on course to surpass his best-ever Fantasy season of 244 points in 2023/24, where he racked up 22 goals and 13 assists. No player has been transferred in by more Fantasy managers than Morgan Rogers (£7.7m) ahead of the Gameweek 5 deadline. Nearly 500,000 people have moved to bring Chelsea’s summer signing into their team; he now sits in just under 40% of squads. Rogers is the only player to register an attacking return (three goals and one assist) in each of the first four Gameweeks. Against Hull last time out, the Englishman scored and claimed a share of the bonus points. Among Blues players, Rogers ranks first for chances created (10) and passes into the penalty box (11). This demonstrates his strong assist potential ahead of Friday’s fixture against Brentford. In an Aston Villa shirt, the Chelsea number 17 netted twice against the Bees in the Premier League. Playing regularly at wing-back, Pedro Neto (£6.5m) has, in recent matches, scored the Blues’ second goal against Brighton and netted in the Carabao Cup, as well as hitting the post at Arsenal with an unfortunate first-half effort. No Blues player has registered more successful passes in the final third (50) than Neto. The Portugal international is one to watch as he is the cheapest Blues attacker in FPL to have started a league game so far. In goal, Emi Martinez (£5.0m) has picked up a save point in each of his three appearances for the club, racking up 15 saves in all. No goalkeeper has made more saves in that time. When the Blues begin keeping clean sheets, Martinez’s ceiling will be high. At £5.0m, he is cheaper than most other goalkeepers playing for top-four contending teams. As usual, Erling Haaland (£15.5m) is a key contender in the captaincy conversation ahead of Manchester City’s home fixture against Sunderland. The Norwegian has racked up some impressive underlying numbers, ranking first among all players for shots (16), shots on target (9) and big chances (7). Haaland has scored in three consecutive Gameweeks, claiming the maximum three bonus points on each occasion. The Black Cats have conceded in both their away matches this season. Elsewhere, Morgan Gibbs-White (£8.0m) is an intriguing option against Coventry City. The English midfielder has registered three attacking returns in the last three Gameweeks and takes penalties for Nottingham Forest. A home fixture against bottom-of-the-table Coventry, who conceded five goals last time out, looks primed for attacking returns. No player has created more big chances (4) so far this season than Gibbs-White, who has been bought by over 370,000 Fantasy managers.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们来看看哪些蓝军球员是必备球员，谁是最具性价比的球员，以及为什么摩根·罗杰斯（770万英镑）是切尔西本周最受欢迎的球员。科尔·帕尔默（970万英镑）继续表现出稳定性，在第四轮比赛中以2-2战平赫尔城的比赛中完成了他本赛季的第四次进攻回归。在哈维·阿隆索的带领下，切尔西的进攻在六场比赛中攻入了惊人的18个进球。我们的 10 号球员在斯坦福桥有 3 次射门并创造了 3 次机会——在第四场比赛中，没有任何切尔西球员能比他更出色。科尔场均得分近 7 分，目前有望超越他在 2023/24 赛季拿下 244 分的最佳梦幻赛季，当时他打进 22 粒进球和 13 次助攻。在第五届比赛截止日期之前，没有比摩根·罗杰斯（770 万英镑）更多的 Fantasy 经理转会的球员了。近 50 万人已将切尔西夏季签约球员带入自己的球队；现在，他在球队中所占的比例不到 40%。罗杰斯是唯一一位在前四周比赛中每一周都有进攻回报（三粒进球和一次助攻）的球员。上一场对阵赫尔城的比赛中，英国人进球并分享了额外积分。在蓝军球员中，罗杰斯在创造机会（10）和传入禁区（11）方面排名第一。这表明了他在周五对阵布伦特福德的比赛之前强大的助攻潜力。身穿阿斯顿维拉球衣的切尔西17号球员在英超联赛对阵蜜蜂队的比赛中梅开二度。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto，650万英镑）经常出任边后卫，在最近的比赛中，他在对阵布莱顿的比赛中攻入了蓝军的第二个进球，并在卡拉宝杯中攻入一球，在对阵阿森纳的比赛中，他在上半场的射门不幸击中门柱。没有哪位蓝军球员在进攻三区的成功传球数（50 次）比内托还要多。这位葡萄牙国脚值得关注，因为他是迄今为止 FPL 联赛中首发身价最低的蓝军攻击手。门将埃米·马丁内斯（Emi Martinez，500万英镑）在为俱乐部出场的三场比赛中，每次都获得了一个扑救点，总共完成了15次扑救。在那段时间里，没有哪个门将做出了更多的扑救。当蓝军开始保持零失球时，马丁内斯的上限将会很高。他的身价为 500 万英镑，比为前四强球队效力的大多数其他门将都要便宜。和往常一样，埃尔林·哈兰德（1550万英镑）是曼城主场对阵桑德兰之前队长讨论中的关键竞争者。挪威人已经取得了一些令人印象深刻的基本数据，在射门（16次）、射正（9次）和绝佳机会（7次）方面在所有球员中排名第一。哈兰德连续三个比赛周进球，每次都获得最多三分奖励。黑猫队本赛季两场客场比赛均失球。在其他地方，摩根·吉布斯-怀特（800万英镑）是对阵考文垂城的一个有趣的选择。这位英格兰中场球员在过去三周比赛中完成了三次进攻，并为诺丁汉森林主罚点球。主场对阵积分榜垫底的考文垂，上一场丢了五个球，看起来已经准备好进攻回报。本赛季到目前为止，没有哪位球员比吉布斯-怀特创造了更多的绝佳机会（4），他已经被超过 370,000 名幻想队主帅买入。

news.title: Don't miss your new-look Chelsea Women programme against Birmingham City!
news.title_zh: 不要错过切尔西女足对阵伯明翰城的全新节目！
news.body_en: Nelly Las gives us an insight into her journey to Chelsea in an exclusive interview in the matchday programme for this weekend’s WSL fixture against Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge. The England Under-20s full-back is settling in nicely to life with the Blues and is loving the levels she is seeing every day in training here. 'I’m really enjoying it,' she says. 'All the girls are really nice, and they’ve really welcomed me. Training’s been really intense, which I’ve really enjoyed as well, and I think it’s great for me to develop as a player. 'You just see all of the players, and how high-level they are. Being around that every day, not just on the pitch, but also off the pitch, and seeing their standards, has been really great. 'I think this is the place I want to be, especially because I’m young. I can really learn from them.' Elsewhere in the programme, there’s a pull-out poster of Sjoeke Nusken, while we put the spotlight on Veerle Buurman to find out more about her career and life away from the pitch, and Aggie Beever-Jones takes us through her journey so far after reaching 100 games for Chelsea. Sandy Baltimore recalls some of her “firsts and favs” in life, and of course there is all the info you need ahead of the game in question, not to mention the latest columns from Sonia Bompastor and Erin Cuthbert. Make sure you pick up your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge!
news.body_zh: 内莉·拉斯 (Nelly Las) 在本周末在斯坦福桥对阵伯明翰城的 WSL 比赛的比赛日节目中接受了独家采访，向我们介绍了她前往切尔西的旅程。这位英格兰20岁以下青年队的后卫正在很好地适应蓝军的生活，并且很喜欢她每天在这里训练时所看到的水平。 “我真的很享受，”她说。 “所有的女孩都非常好，她们非常欢迎我。训练非常激烈，我也很享受，我认为这对我作为一名球员的发展非常有利。 “你只看到所有的球员，以及他们的水平有多高。每天都围绕着这一点，不仅在球场上，而且在球场外，看到他们的标准，真的很棒。 “我认为这就是我想去的地方，尤其是因为我还年轻。我真的可以向他们学习。在节目的其他地方，有一张 Sjoeke Nusken 的拉出海报，同时我们将焦点放在维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 身上，以了解更多关于她在球场之外的职业生涯和生活的信息，而阿吉·比弗-琼斯 (Aggie Beever-Jones) 则带领我们回顾她在为切尔西出场 100 场比赛后迄今为止的旅程。桑迪·巴尔的摩 (Sandy Baltimore) 回忆起她人生中的一些“第一次和最爱”，当然，这里有您在比赛前需要的所有信息，更不用说索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 和艾琳·卡斯伯特 (Erin Cuthbert) 的最新专栏。请务必从斯坦福桥周边的节目销售商处购买您的副本！

news.title: Blues duo selected in England squad
news.title_zh: 蓝军二人组入选英格兰队
news.body_en: Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers have been selected in the England squad for the upcoming September and October international break. The Three Lions will play four matches during an extended FIFA window as they kick off the new UEFA Nations League campaign. Rogers retains his place in the squad from the summer’s FIFA World Cup, where he made seven appearances for England as they reached the semi-finals and then beat France in the third-place play-off. Palmer returns to the squad for this international window, having last been selected by England boss Thomas Tuchel for the pair of friendlies in March. The 24-year-old will be hoping to add to his 14 caps and two goals for the Three Lions. Palmer and Rogers' inclusions come after a brilliant start to the season at club level, with both dovetailing alongside Joao Pedro to devastating effect in the Premier League; they have produced a combined five goals and three assists across our four top-flight matches. England will begin their Nations League campaign by hosting World Cup winners Spain at Wembley Stadium on Saturday 26 September, before back-to-back away games in Czechia on Tuesday 29 September and Croatia on Saturday 3 October. They conclude their four matches during this international window back in London on Tuesday 6 October, when Croatia will be the visitors to Wembley. news.title: Chelsea FC Women launches best-in-class Player Maternity Policy as part of new family-friendly player care framework
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足推出一流的球员生育政策，作为新的家庭友好型球员护理框架的一部分
news.body_en: Enhanced policy provides fully paid leave, personalised pregnancy support and dedicated return-to-play medical care, alongside new adoption, parental leave and fertility support. Chelsea FC Women (CFCW) has today announced a new, enhanced suite of family-friendly policies designed to provide our players with greater financial security, personalised care and comprehensive support through pregnancy, parenthood and other family-building journeys, as the club continues our ambition to set the standard for player care in women’s football. Chelsea FC has always been proud to offer industry-leading maternity support, but players face a unique challenge in balancing peak physical performance on the pitch with the demands of pregnancy, post-partum recovery and balancing motherhood with their return to play. We are therefore setting out a new suite of policies to provide wraparound, tailored support for our players that will better help them navigate starting a family. The centrepiece of the new framework is the club’s Player Maternity Policy, offering personalised support throughout pregnancy and dedicated medical care to support each player’s individual return to professional football. The policy has been developed to give players greater financial security and confidence planning for parenthood, recognises that every player’s journey is different, while ensuring their health and wellbeing remain the priority throughout pregnancy and their transition back to elite sport. The club’s enhanced approach includes: Personalised support throughout pregnancy, with the right to access private scans and delivery options Post-partum recovery support, led by the club’s industry-leading experts covering physical, mental and emotional aspects of postnatal health Financial support for a partner or nanny to travel to away fixtures up to one year after a player’s return to play, to ensure those early months of returning to play post-delivery are fully supported Enhanced adoption and parental leave policies, recognising that there is no single path to becoming a parent Subsidised childcare, a contribution to childcare costs when a player returns to rehab or training These policies follow our recently announced partnership with Fertility Plus, which includes the creation of a Player Value in Kind Fund to financially support players exploring their fertility and family-building options. The breadth of policies has been comprehensively reviewed and revised as part of CFCW’s pursuit to be never done challenging ourself and never done pushing for progress. Most recently this ambition has been brought to life with all of the team’s Barclays Women’s Super League matches now being played at Stamford Bridge, through working with industry-leading partners delivering campaign-winning work and enhancing policies to offer our players the very best care, not only on the pitch, but in all areas of life and at every stage of their careers. Aki Mandhar, Chief Executive Officer for Chelsea FC Women, said: ‘There is no single path to becoming a parent, and our responsibility is to ensure our players have access to the support, security and care they deserve, whatever their individual journey looks like. Our enhanced Player Maternity Policy, alongside our adoption, parental leave and fertility support, is designed to give our players confidence that they will be supported throughout their careers with us.’ Phil Radley, Sporting Director for Chelsea FC Women, added: ‘We are proud of the progress we are making, but we are never done looking for ways to do more. Our ambition is to build the best women’s sports organisation in the world; one that truly values its players and gives them everything they need to thrive – both as athletes and as people.’
news.body_zh: 强化政策提供全薪休假、个性化怀孕支持和专门的重返赛场医疗护理，以及新收养、育儿假和生育支持。切尔西足球俱乐部女足 (CFCW) 今天宣布了一套新的、增强的家庭友好政策，旨在为我们的球员提供更大的财务保障、个性化护理以及在怀孕、生育和其他家庭建设过程中的全面支持，同时俱乐部继续致力于为女足球员护理制定标准。切尔西足球俱乐部一直为提供行业领先的产妇支持而感到自豪，但球员们面临着独特的挑战，需要平衡球场上的最佳身体表现与怀孕、产后恢复的需求，以及平衡母性与重返赛场之间的关系。因此，我们制定了一套新的政策，为我们的玩家提供全方位、量身定制的支持，更好地帮助他们组建家庭。新框架的核心是俱乐部的球员生育政策，在整个怀孕期间提供个性化支持和专门的医疗护理，以支持每位球员重返职业足球。该政策的制定是为了给球员更大的经济保障和信心，为父母做计划，认识到每个球员的旅程都是不同的，同时确保他们的健康和福祉在整个怀孕期间和重返精英运动的过渡过程中仍然是首要任务。俱乐部的强化方法包括： 怀孕期间的个性化支持，有权获得私人扫描和分娩选项 产后恢复支持，由俱乐部业界领先的专家领导，涵盖产后健康的身体、心理和情感方面 为伴侣或保姆提供财务支持，在球员重返比赛后一年内前往客场比赛，以确保产后返回比赛的最初几个月得到充分支持 加强收养和育儿假政策，认识到成为父母没有单一的途径补贴儿童保育，当球员返回康复中心或训练时支付儿童保育费用这些政策遵循我们最近宣布的与 Fertility Plus 的合作伙伴关系，其中包括创建球员实物价值基金，以在经济上支持球员探索他们的生育和家庭建设选择。作为CFCW永不停歇地挑战自我、永不止步地推动进步的追求的一部分，对政策的广度进行了全面审查和修订。最近，这一雄心壮志随着球队在斯坦福桥举行的所有巴克莱女子超级联赛比赛而得以实现，通过与行业领先的合作伙伴合作，提供赢得竞选的工作并加强政策，为我们的球员提供最好的照顾，不仅在球场上，而且在生活的各个领域和职业生涯的每个阶段。切尔西女足首席执行官阿基·曼达尔 (Aki Mandhar) 表示：“成为父母没有单一的途径，我们的责任是确保我们的球员能够获得他们应得的支持、安全和照顾，无论他们的个人经历如何。我们强化的球员生育政策，以及我们的收养、育儿假和生育支持，旨在让我们的球员相信，他们将在整个职业生涯中得到我们的支持。”切尔西女足体育总监菲尔·拉德利补充道：“我们为我们正在取得的进步感到自豪，但我们永远不会停止寻找做得更多的方法。我们的目标是建立世界上最好的女子体育组织；一个真正重视球员并为他们提供成长所需的一切的球队——无论是作为运动员还是作为人。

news.title: Alonso confident there’s ‘more to come’ from Cole Palmer
news.title_zh: 阿隆索相信科尔·帕尔默会“带来更多”
news.body_en: Cole Palmer has started the season in excellent form and Xabi Alonso believes our No10 can reach even greater heights if he keeps enjoying his football. Palmer was outstanding in his first two campaigns at Stamford Bridge, but injury made it difficult for him to replicate that level of performance in 2025/26. He didn’t go to the FIFA World Cup this summer, and the break afforded him a chance to rest and reset. It has served Palmer well, with the attacker already finding the net four times and registering two assists. We will find out today if Palmer is back in the England fold, but for now Alonso has urged him to just keep playing with a smile on his face. ‘I think there's some more to come from Cole,’ said Alonso. ‘I'm very happy with Cole. The way he has prepared since the first day of pre-season, he's been there. He has shown this desire to enjoy his game. ‘What he wants is to enjoy his game, to have this good feeling on the pitch, to have this connection with players around. If he gets that, the rest will come. England will come, winning more games will come. ‘That will come naturally because he's a top-level player and that's the main thing, for him to feel good.’ Alonso has not been working with Palmer for long, but he can already tell he has a unique personality that will continue to stand him in good stead. ‘I've been here for two months. Day by day I get to know the players better, and I get to know Cole better, and Cole gets to know me better. ‘It’s about having connection, having contact, and Cole is a special man.’
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默以出色的状态开始了本赛季，哈维·阿隆索相信，如果他继续享受足球，我们的 10 号球员可以达到更高的高度。帕尔默在斯坦福桥的前两个赛季表现出色，但伤病让他很难在2025/26赛季复制这样的表现水平。今年夏天他没有参加世界杯，这次休息给了他休息和重新调整的机会。这对帕尔默来说效果很好，这位攻击手已经四次进球并送出两次助攻。我们今天就会知道帕尔默是否重返英格兰队，但目前阿隆索敦促他脸上带着微笑继续比赛。 “我认为科尔还会做出更多贡献，”阿隆索说。 “我对科尔非常满意。从季前赛第一天起他就一直在做准备。他表现出了享受比赛的渴望。 “他想要的是享受比赛，在球场上拥有良好的感觉，与周围的球员建立联系。如果他得到了这一点，剩下的就会到来。英格兰将会到来，赢得更多比赛将会到来。 “这会很自然，因为他是一名顶级球员，这对他来说感觉良好是最重要的。”阿隆索与帕尔默合作的时间并不长，但他已经可以看出帕尔默拥有独特的个性，这将继续对他有利。 ‘我已经在这里两个月了。日复一日，我越来越了解球员，我也越来越了解科尔，科尔也越来越了解我。 “这是关于建立联系、建立联系，科尔是一个特别的人。”

news.title: Brentford vs Chelsea: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 布伦特福德 vs 切尔西：你需要知道的一切
news.body_en: Chelsea’s localised start to the season on all fronts continues with a seventh match in succession played in the capital. Club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton preview our trip to Brentford’s Gtech Community Stadium. The 8pm Friday kick-off will also be the Blues’ last west London derby on the road of the current league campaign. End-to-end 2-2 draws at the weekend prompted both managers to wistfully wish for a ‘boring’ game – 51 goals have already been scored in matches across all competitions involving the west London pair. The unbeaten Bees have drawn three on the spin in the top flight, but won 2-1 at Reading in midweek to reach the last 16 of the Carabao Cup. Chelsea's ball was already in the round four bowl so Xabi Alonso had a free week to prepare his players for this fixture after Saturday’s 2-2 home draw with Hull. Alonso and Keith Andrews will lock horns in the technical area for the first time, but at Euro 2012 they vied for midfield supremacy as Spain beat the Republic of Ireland 4-0, a win in which Chelsea’s Fernando Torres scored twice. In this same fixture last season at the Gtech, the Blues came from behind to lead, but conceded a last-gasp equaliser for 2-2 and a share of the spoils. Either club claiming all three points would lift them to third place in the table going into the weekend action. After that comes FIFA’s three-week, four-match international break, with club football resuming on 10 October, when Chelsea host Bournemouth. Alonso confirmed that Joao Pedro and Reece James, along with the whole of his Chelsea squad, remain in contention to face Brentford. There were concerns over Joao Pedro after the striker withdrew from the Brazil squad for the upcoming international break, and James as he missed the start of training on Tuesday. ‘In terms of injuries and in terms of the squad, we are having the last training session on Friday so no-one is ruled out for us,’ he explained in his pre-match press conference. ‘So I prefer to be cautious and we will wait to take the final decision on every player. We will see if Joao is ready to play, it’s a possibility. For Reece, it was just a decision for Tuesday and we see his development and  we will decide.’ It was a similar story when Alonso discussed the potential return from injury of Moises Caicedo, Marco Palestra and Jordan Henderson. ‘Moises is getting closer and we will take the final decision on the team and on the squad that is coming to Brentford. Before the players know we need to assess all the positions with the last training and we will make the decision for the game.’ One of Chelsea’s most memorable trips to Maine Road came in a rare Friday night match in early May 1984, Match Of The Day coverage of the tussle with Manchester City vying with That’s My Boy on ITV for the viewing public’s attention. It was the first time a Division Two match had been given the BBC’s live treatment and already-promoted Chelsea struck twice in six minutes to show why they and not the Cityzens were rejoining the elite. Fast forward eight years to 11 December 1992 and a dour 0-0 between Middlesbrough and Chelsea meant Teesside hosted the first Friday night match in Premier League history. The August 2002 clash between the Blues and Manchester United at Stamford Bridge was brought forward to the end of the working week to avoid Notting Hill Carnival congestion. The hosts twice led though William Gallas then Boudewijn Zenden, but the Mancunians levelled on each occasion and an entertaining game finished 2-2. Friday 12 May 2017 at West Bromwich Albion proved a red letter day in the Black Country for the Blues. The hosts doggedly held out until Michy Batshuayi’s opportunistic winner and at the final whistle the title-winning celebrations were lengthy and joyful. Last season, the same night of the week served up substantial away wins on two fronts – 5-1 at West Ham United in the league and 4-0 at Hull City in the FA Cup. Those were the Blues’ second and third-highest scores of the season and Pedro Neto notched four across the two games. Prior to that, a Marc Cucurella goal without reply had claimed all three points at home to Man Utd in May 2025, making the 3-0 at Brighton & Hove Albion two months earlier our most recent Friday loss. No Premier League goalkeeper has made more saves this season than Chelsea’s Emi Martinez or Brentford’s Caoimhin Kelleher (both 15). The Blues have recorded and sustained the joint-most shots on target in the top flight, 24 for and 26 against. Chelsea have broken the deadlock in the opening seven minutes of all four Premier League fixtures to date – in the first minute at Fulham, fourth at home to Brighton, second at Arsenal and seventh against Hull. Last weekend, Cole Palmer marked his 100th Premier League appearance with his 71st goal contribution (49 goals, 22 assists). Only Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink produced more in his first century for the Blues. Joao Pedro has already set up and scored a goal in the same top-flight game three times this season, matching his best performance in any campaign in England. The Bees have opened the scoring in each of their past three league games, and conceded the equaliser on each occasion.
news.body_zh: 切尔西在各方面的本地化开局仍在继续，连续第七场比赛在首都举行。俱乐部历史学家 Rick Glanvill 和俱乐部统计学家 Paul Dutton 预览了我们前往布伦特福德 Gtech 社区体育场的旅程。周五晚上 8 点的开球也将是蓝军本赛季联赛中最后一场西伦敦德比。周末双方2-2战平，让两位主帅都渴望一场“无聊”的比赛——这对西伦敦组合在所有比赛中已经打进了51个进球。保持不败的蜜蜂队在顶级联赛中已经打了三场平局，但周中在雷丁队以2-1获胜，进入卡拉宝杯16强。切尔西的球已经进入第四轮比赛，因此在周六主场 2-2 战平赫尔城后，哈维·阿隆索有一周的空闲时间为他的球员准备这场比赛。阿隆索和基思·安德鲁斯将首次在技术领域交锋，但在 2012 年欧洲杯上，他们争夺中场霸主地位，西班牙队以 4-0 击败爱尔兰队，切尔西队的费尔南多·托雷斯在这场比赛中梅开二度。上赛季在 Gtech 的同一场比赛中，蓝军后来居上领先，但最后时刻扳平比分，2-2 平，并分享了战利品。任何一支球队如果能够全取三分，那么他们在周末比赛中的排名就会上升到第三位。此后，国际足联将迎来为期三周、四场比赛的国际比赛日，俱乐部足球将于 10 月 10 日恢复，届时切尔西将主场迎战伯恩茅斯。阿隆索证实若奥·佩德罗和里斯·詹姆斯以及他的切尔西全队仍然有资格对阵布伦特福德。若奥·佩德罗因即将到来的国际比赛日而退出巴西队，人们对这位前锋感到担忧，而詹姆斯也因错过了周二的训练开始而受到关注。 “就伤病和阵容而言，我们将在周五进行最后一次训练，所以没有人被排除在外，”他在赛前新闻发布会上解释道。 “所以我更愿意保持谨慎，我们将等待对每位球员做出最终决定。我们将看看若昂是否准备好上场比赛，这是有可能的。对于里斯来说，这只是周二的决定，我们会看到他的发展，然后我们会做出决定。当阿隆索讨论莫伊塞斯·凯塞多、马可·帕莱斯特拉和乔丹·亨德森伤愈的可能性时，也是类似的故事。 “莫伊塞斯的日子越来越近了，我们将对球队和前往布伦特福德的阵容做出最终决定。在球员们知道之前，我们需要评估最后一次训练中的所有位置，然后为比赛做出决定。” 切尔西最难忘的缅因路之旅之一是 1984 年 5 月上旬一场罕见的周五晚上的比赛，英国独立电视台 (ITV) 的每日比赛报道了曼城队与“我的男孩”之间的争斗，以吸引观众的注意力。这是 BBC 第一次对二级联赛的比赛进行现场直播，已经晋级的切尔西在六分钟内梅开二度，以表明为什么是他们而不是城民重新跻身精英行列。一晃八年过去了，到了 1992 年 12 月 11 日，米德尔斯堡和切尔西之间的一场惨烈的 0-0 比赛意味着蒂赛德举办了英超历史上第一场周五晚上的比赛。 2002 年 8 月蓝军与曼联在斯坦福桥的比赛被提前到工作周结束时进行，以避免诺丁山狂欢节的拥堵。主队先后两次领先威廉·加拉斯（William Gallas）和布德维恩·岑登（Boudewijn Zenden），但曼彻斯特人每次都扳平比分，最终以 2-2 的比分结束了一场精彩的比赛。 2017 年 5 月 12 日星期五在西布罗姆维奇球场对蓝军来说是黑国的一个红字日。主队顽强地坚持到了米奇·巴舒亚伊的机会主义制胜球，终场哨声响起时，夺冠庆祝活动漫长而欢乐。上赛季，当周的同一晚，球队在两场客场取得了巨大的胜利——联赛中 5-1 战胜西汉姆联，以及足总杯中 4-0 战胜赫尔城。这是蓝军本赛季第二高和第三高的得分，佩德罗·内托在两场比赛中拿下四分。在此之前，马克·库库雷拉(Marc Cucurella)在2025年5月主场对阵曼联的比赛中凭借一记无人回应的进球全取三分，这使得两个月前对阵布莱顿的0-3成为我们最近周五的一场失利。本赛季英超联赛中扑救次数最多的门将是切尔西队的埃米·马丁内斯和布伦特福德队的考伊欣·凯莱赫（均为 15 次）。 蓝军是顶级联赛中射正次数最多的球队，其中 24 次射门，26 次射正。迄今为止，切尔西在所有四场英超比赛的开场七分钟内都打破了僵局——对阵富勒姆的第一分钟，主场对阵布莱顿的第四分钟，对阵阿森纳的第二分钟和对阵赫尔城的第七分钟。上周末，科尔·帕尔默在英超联赛中出场 100 次，贡献了 71 粒进球（49 粒进球，22 次助攻）。只有吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克（Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink）在他的第一个世纪为蓝调做出了更多贡献。若昂·佩德罗本赛季已经在同一场顶级联赛中3次助攻并攻入一球，追平了他在英格兰任何一个赛季的最佳表现。蜜蜂队在过去三场联赛中每场都首开纪录，并且每次都失球扳平比分。
